tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med thugs rjes byang chub thugs bskyed cing*/ /brtson pa'i dbang gis bskal par tshogs bsags nas/ /smon lam mthu yis gdul bya'i mgon gyur pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab yon tan thogs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ / bdag la chags med 'gro kun bdag mdzad phyir/ /bzang po'i yon tan rab rdzogs dpal mnga' ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad gus mchod nas/ /de nyid gdul bya'i don la byon pa y-i/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las ngo mtshar rmad byung ba/ /tshur rol mthong ba'i blo ngor gsal ba rnams/ /rang gzhan dad pa'i brtan pa gso phyir bri/ /'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ snyigs ma'i dus su 'gran zla thams cad dang bral zhing*/ spyan ras gzugs mi'i gzugs su sprul nas/ gdul bya rnams kyi don mdzad pa/ rgyal ba'i sras mtshan brjod par dka' ba/ thogs med rin po che de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa zab cing rgya che ba rnams ni/ tshur rol mthong ba rnams kyis rtogs pa'am brjod par mi nus kyi/ rin po che nyid kyi drung du/ bdag gis spobs pa bskyed nas/ drung gi rnam thar zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ bslab gsum blangs pas nyes ltung dri mas gos/ / thos bsam byas pas tshig bzhin gting ma rnyed/ /gzhan don byas pas rang don me ltar 'bar/ / dben par bsdad pas snyoms las dbang du song*/ / zhes pa 'di byon nas/ sngar yang rnam thar 'dod zer ba rnams la de skad byas/ bdag gi rnam thar de rang lags so gsungs/ de ltar lags kyang*/ sku 'khrungs tshul/ rab tu byung nas thugs sbyong mdzad tshul/

bla ma rnams la chos gsan tshul la sogs pa'i rim pa gcig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ de rnams bzhed na 'di ltar lags so zhes gsung las thos pa dang*/ spyan sngar yun ring du bzhugs pa 'ga' re las thos pa'i mdzad pa'i tshul cung zad 'dir brjod na/ de la rgyal ba'i sras po 'di nyid kyi gdung rus ni/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan yang dgon pa chen po'i gdung rus dang gcig pa/ 'jig rten na che zhing btsun pa bstod yin la thog byung gis dogs pa la yang*/ nged bstod yin gsungs pas thog thub pa yin pas/ gdung rus bzang po yin no/ / 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ rgya dkar nag gi so mtshams/ 'gri lcam mched bdun gyi nub zhol/ dpal ldan sa skya dang nye ba na brag skya zhes bya bar/ yab dkon mchog dpal zhes bya ba/ yum 'bum sgron zhes bya ba rus pa phyag yin pa/ de gnyis kyi sras su shing mo lug gi lo la sku 'khrungs shing*/ mtshan yang dkon mchog bzang po zhes gsol lo/ /yum gyi lhums su zhugs dus/ yum lus bde zhing sems dga' ba dang*/ lhag par snying rje dang ldan zhing*/ bltams pa'i dus su yang*/ 'ja' dang 'od la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung ngo zhes grag go /yab mes rnams kyang*/ yul dpon dang mgo thon 'ba' zhig byung zhing*/ a me'i mtshan dkon mchog bya ba yin/ de'i mched ya sa skya dpon grags bya ba/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i nye gnas yin no/ /'khrungs ma thag nas/ theg chen gyi rigs sad pa'i rtags snying rje chen po mnga' ba ni/ bu chung smra shes tsam gyi dus su/ nyin gcig yum gyi pang na gnas pa na/ rlung po 'khor khyer byed pa gcig gis shing lo gcig nam mkha' la khyer ba gzigs nas drag tu bshums pa la/ yum gyis ci byung dris pa la/ de la phyag mdzub btsugs nas/ sems can gcig nam mkha' la khyer song gsung ba dang*/ 'byon shes tsam gyi dus su/ nyin gcig phyir gshegs song ba dang*/

yud tsam zhig nas gos med du byung gos gar song dris pas/ sems can gcig 'khyags 'dug pas de la bkab yod gsungs/ ltar phyin pas/ sho mangs kyi phung po ba mo skya khor ba gcig la g.yog nas mtha' la rdos mnan 'dug byis pa gzhan brdungs pa na/ drung nas kyang bshums pa gcig yod zer ba dang*/ bshums pa na dpe cha shog 'khyar phyag tu gtad pas shin tu mnyes nas bshums 'phro chad pa dang*/ rtsed mo phal cher mchod rten bzhengs pa dang*/ chos 'chad nyan la sogs dge ba 'ba' zhig mdzad pa yod zer ba bden lags sam zhus pas/ de ltar grags gda' ste bdag rang gis ni mi dran lags dran tsam na chos la gzhan gyis thu yogs la sogs mi gus pa byas tsa na/ bdag la mi bzod pa chen po skye zhing*/ byis pa rang gi dus na/ bzod pa dang snying rje cung zad yod/ de'i stobs kyis su la yang tshig rtsub ye smra mi nus/ byis pa gzhan dang rtse ba na/ gzhan pham nas sems mi dga' ba bdag gis mi bzod cing*/ rang pham yang mi dga' ba tsam mi skye ba gcig dang*/ bdag po rtswa shing la sogs thu ru phyin na yang grogs kyis rnyed na/ rang gis ma rnyed kyang sdug bsngal tsam mi 'byung zhing*/ rang gis rnyed kyang grogs kyis ma rnyed na/ khong tsho la pha ma sogs kyis 'thab tu yong snyam nas sdug bsngal chen po yong ba gcig yod pas/ res 'ga' rang gi de nas byin/ res 'ga' thu rog byas te/ de'ang brtag na/ bdag gi ma ni lo ngo gsum nas 'das/ pha lo lnga nas 'das/ de nas lo dgu'i bar du a phyi chos nyid 'dren gyis bskyangs shing shin tu byams po byas pas/ 'thab tu mi yong snyam pa'i snyems kyang yin pa 'dra gsungs/ sa skya dkar phubs kyi sgor byis pa'i dus su mi gcig gis mgo la brgyab pas/ khong khro ba ma byung ba dang*/ dran nas shig bskyur ma myong gsung zhing*/ de ltar gzhan sdug na/ rang de bas sdug cing*/ gzhan bde na yang*/ de bas ches bde ba ni skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba yin no/

/de dus bsam gling pa'i gdung rgyud zhang sgom ri pa'i dbon po/ sangs rgyas dbon bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i sa lugs kyi dbang yang zhus so/ /dgung lo dgu la a phyi 'das nas/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i bar la spun khu bo rin chen bkra shis kyis bskyangs shing*/ klog yig legs pa bslabs btsun par 'jug pa'i bdag rkyen yang byas pas shin tu drin che gsungs/ de nas byas pa shes shing byas pa gzod/ byas pa chud zos mi byed pa'i/ / mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas/ /ces pa ltar khu bo la drin lan du/ khyod tshe 'di la ma chags pa'i chos gcig mdzod/ 'tsho ba thung na bdag gi kyang bsod snyoms byas nas bskyal ba lags/ zhes pa'i zhal bskos mdzad pas khong gis kyang de bzhin du mdzad do/ /dgung lo bcu pa'i dus su/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston pa la/ bsam gling gi tshogs su sher snying gi mdo sgrub/ dbu ma sems bskyed/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgom bzlas/ sgra nag gi mngon rtogs phar tshad/ mngon pa gsum gyi lung rnams gsan/ ༈ dgung lo bcu bzhi pa la bsam gling pa'i gdung rgyud/ mkhan po rin chen dpal 'bar bas mkhan po dang de'i gcung po mkhan po rin po che dpal bzang pa la slob dpon zhus/ dge slong rdor rin pa la grib tshod pa zhus nas/ spre'u lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro'i cha la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i sgor rab tu byung nas/ mtshan yang bzang po dpal zhes par gsol to/ / de nas brtsams te sku gshegs kyi bar du/ kha na ma tho ba phra mo ci yang khyad du mi gsod par spang blang mdzad/ chos rje pa nyid kyi zhal nas/ lpags thul gyon pa tsam la yang nyes par song dgongs nas/ ya nga ba'i rnam pa chen po byas te/ dus phyis 'dul ba thos pas de tsam rang gi spyod lam dog pa rang yang mi dgos par 'dug gsungs/ de nas rab tu byung ba'i bya ba/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/

/ sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i don nyams su blang bar dgongs te/ bo dong e bsam gling ba'i dgon lag yin pa dang*/ mkhan po dpal bzang ba de dus e'i bla chos la yod pa'i gsung nas/ 'di nas btsun pa bcu gcig e ru slob gnyer la gtong bas/ 'di dang 'di byon zer ba la/ chos rje pa/ ston pa bsod rgyal/ jo sras kun bsod/ tshul khrims dpal/ dpal seng rnams kyis dpal e'i gtsug lag khang du/ dbyar chos la phebs par byon nas/ bla ma byang sems rin chen mgon/ bla ma rin chen seng ge /slob dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon dpal gyi bzang po/ slob dpon bkra shis mgon rnams la mngon pa kun las btus gsan cing*/ thugs sbyongs mdzad/ thog ma nyid bdag 'dzin gyi kha zin skyung ba la thugs gzhol zhing*/ yon tan du sbed pa kho na mdzad pas gzhan pas blo gros kyi nus pa chung zhing dman pa'i tshul bzung nas/ grogs mched rnams la 'gran sems dang*/ phrag dog gis khyad gsod ma mdzad par/ mngon pa kun las btus la lo lnga'i bar du slob gnyer mdzad/ grogs ci rigs pas de gong du bshad pas chog pa'ang byung gi /gnas lugs la chos rje pa kho na mkhas par byung ngo*/ /de nas bshad slongs kyi grogs la ston pa nam rdor gyis gnas rnying bar du byon pas/ 'o skol gnyis kas bshad gsar ba yin byas na rnyed pa che bar yong byas pas/ chos rje pa'i gsung nas/ brdzun byas na mi yong gsungs pas/ ston pa nam rdor dad nas/ ngo mtshar che nga la khyed lta bu'i grogs mched dam pa yod gsungs/ bkur bsti chen po byed do/ / de dus dpal sdings pa'i mkhan chen gra sangs pa la phar phyin chos thun gcig gsan/ grang po lung pa'i mkhan po thugs rje rgyal mtshan la/ bka' gdams chos thun gcig gsan/ de'i dbyar chos kyi dus su zha lu'i bar du grwa bskor dang*/ bshad slongs thun mong du byas te/ ston pa nam rdor gyis grogs byas nas byon pas/

mkhas pa'i grags pa'ang thob bo/ /de dus kyi ston pa nam rdor ni/ bla ma nam rdor yin/ nged grwa tshang gcig cing yun ring 'grogs pas/ rus dad che/ dang po rang nas snying rje che/ ma nus pa dang bkres pa mthong dus/ gsol 'phro yan chad ster zhing*/ da nang gsol rgyu med kyang tshol gsog dang 'dod 'dun ye mi mdzad/ nas khal re tsam byung tsa na/ 'di zad tsa na 'khos gcig 'char gsung zhing*/ 'jigs chags dang thugs las mi mdzad pa'i skyes mchog ngo mtshar ba gcig dang po rang nas yod gsungs/ chos rje pa rang yang*/ nga la gsog sems ma skyes pas 'phral lto skyid pa gcig byung gsungs/ de nas bsam gling brang mo cher/ nyi la 'bum bya ba shes rab can gcig gis zla ba gcig tsam mtshams byas te/ mjad pa gzhon byang gi ṭi ka'i thog nas gzigs rtog mdzad pas snga ma'i bag chags sad cing skyes stobs kyi shes rab phul du phy-in pas/ gzhan gyis lo'i bar du sbyangs pa bas/ bskyed che bar shin tu mkhas par byung zhing*/ le lo'i dbang gis shas cher ma 'bad kyang*/ / 'on kyang kho bo'i blo dang phrad pa na/ / shes bya'i tshig don lhan cig dmigs nges yin/ /zhes pa'ang gsung zhes grag go /de dus bla zhig byang chub rdo rje'i dus mchod kyi mang ja'i gral du/ rigs grwa byed pa'i rigs chung gi gseb na/ byung ba yang bzhugs pa la/ 'jam dbyangs rong pa nyi la rgyal mtshan bya ba shin du mkhas pa zhig yod pa na re/ khyed blo gsar ba btsun chung bzang po dpal dang bcas pa rnams la dri ba bya rgyu 'ga' zhig yod/ mngon pa nas/ zang zing med pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal ba zhes bya ba gcig bshad 'dug ste/ zang zing med pa'i tshor ba yin na sdug bsngal yin pa'i dam bca' bud zer ba 'di la/ bsam mno thong la lan thob zer ba la/ gzhan ni lan thebs pa ma byung*/ drung gi thugs dgongs la/ de lta bu gzhung na yod pas 'di ji ltar yin bsams pas/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa la zang zing med/

nyon mongs med kyang de dag la/ / las kyi nus pa mthong ba yin/ /zhes sdug bsngal 'byung bar bshad yod pa de'i lugs kyi sgrub byed dang*/ 'gal spong gsungs nas brtsod zla chos dang mthun par pham bar mdzad de/ nga thogs med gsar ma yin gsungs pas/ mtshan yang thogs med ces de nas grags shing*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung ngo*/ / de'i dgun mngon pa kun las btus kyang bshad mdzad cing*/ dgung lo nyi shu pa la bshad gsar mdzad/ chos gsungs pas/ 'di thogs med rang yin par 'dug ces mkhas pa'i grags pa thob bo/ /de nas slob dpon 'jam dbyangs nyi ma la rnam nges gsan nas thugs sbyongs mdzad/ nyer drug la dngul chur byon nas/ ri pa dpal she la na ro chos drug dang*/ zha ma nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po stod lugs su grags pa gsan/ nyer bdun la e ru dge bshes mdzad/ de nas sa skyar slob dpon gzhon rgyal ba la rnam nges tshar gcig gsan zhing*/ drung pa rang gis kyang chos gsung dus/ gong ma'i sku rim pa/ dge bshes mang po rnam rgyal la spyan drangs pa'i tshogs dpon la 'byon par zhu zer ba la/ 'byor pa ni ci yang med cing*/ de nyin rnam rgyal la byon nas/ srang phyed de'i 'bul ba sngar srol yod cing chos nyan don gnyer ba ni gnyis tsam las med na'ang*/ nga la chos bshad dgos gsungs nas/ rnam rgyal la ma byon par chos gsungs/ sa skyar yang dge bshes che rtogs su gyur kyang*/ nyom chung gi spyod pa mdzad pas/ grags pa che rgyu med pa gcig yod gsungs/ rong pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan dgos kyi slob dpon yin/ tshad ma'ang shin tu mkhas par mkhyen to/ / gzhan yang rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sdai lnga/ bsdus pa'i sdom rnam gnyis/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan la sogs pa byams chos lnga/ de dang 'brel pa'i bstan chos chen po nyi shu rnams dang*/ khyad par du mdo sde rgyan mngon rtogs rgyan/ rgyud bla/

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug rnams la lo brgyad kyi bar du thugs sbyongs mdzad cing*/ lung rigs kyi sgros gleng mdzad pa'i dus su yang*/ byams pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin/ klu sgrub rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin/ chos grags rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin gsung ba zhig yod ces bgres pa rnams gsung zhing*/ e ru dus chos la yang mngon pa kun las btus/ phar phyin rnam nges/ mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla/ spyod 'jug rnams gsungs/ bla ma byang sems rin chen mgon po la/ dgra nag 'khor chen/ sgrol ma/ tshe dpag med/ bde mchog kyai rdor/ kun rig rnams kyi dbang*/ phar phyin spyod 'jug /thub pa dgongs rgyan/ theg bsdus bskor gsum/ sems bskyed sa lugs/ rnam rgyal rjes gnang*/ nyi shu pa dang*/ sum cu pa'i rtsa 'grel/ byams chos lnga rtsa 'grel/ mgon po lcaṃ gral gyi rjes gnang gtor chog la sogs pa las tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston pas mdzad pa'i a phyi ma'i gtor chog /gtor dbang rnams gsan/ bla ma rin ye ba la byams chos rnams dang*/ smon 'jug sems bskyed/ dpe chos rin spungs/ man ngag rin spungs rnams gsan/ bla ma gnur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan dpal la/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'byung ba/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ kun rig /rnam 'joms/ phyag rdor 'gro bzang/ dpal mchog rtse mo rig bsdus/ sbyong rgyud/ dpal mchog de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa/ ko sa la rgyan/ a ba ta ra/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud/ yo ga'i dbang ka la sogs pa gsan no/ /rin chen shes rab 'bum pa'i drung du/ dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang*/ dbang mdor bstan/ sbyor drug gi khrid/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ rten 'brel snying po/ dmar khrid/ bcu gcig zhal gyi rgya gzhung dpal mos mdzad pa/ phar phyin drug gi gzungs/ sa bcu pa sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs rnams gsan no/

/dgung lo sum cu pa byi ba'i lo la/ dpal e'i gtsug lag khang du/ mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mgon/ las kyi slob dpon bla ma nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ gsang ston bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ grib tshod pa slob dpon shākya byang chub/ dad pa'i dge 'dun bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum la sogs pa la zhus nas/ tshes drug gi snga gro'i cha la bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad do/ khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar gces spras su mdzad cing*/ 'dod pa'i rtsa ba gtan nas spangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad do/ /'chad nyan mdzad pa'i gnas skabs su/ longs spyod kyis cung zad phongs pa la/ brtse bar 'dod pa 'ga' res lag len bslabs nas/ dbang bskur la sogs mdzad na/ longs spyod 'bad med du 'byung bas/ lag len bslabs pa drag ces pa'i lan du/ kho bo lag len byed na 'di ltar byed gsungs nas/ rgyal sras lag len brtsams te/ grog nang gcig tu zhus dag mdzad pas/ shog gu gcig kyang ma lus par rlung pos khyer song*/ der phyogs thams cad du dar cha yong ba la lta ba 'dra/ yang blo la sa le 'dug pas bskyar nas bris pa yin gsung*/ de dus e dkar phu ba'i sgrub mchod la 'byon par zhu zer ba la/ bshad nyan gyi gegs su song dogs nas ma byon/ yang bla ma kun bkra ba bskyar nas gdan 'dren du byung*/ nyid cag cis kyang sgrub mchod la 'byon dgos par gda' zer ba la/ gzhan bus ci yang mi shes pa nyid cag rang la thugs rgyus bdog pa gsungs pas/ de ka nyid cag gis ci yang mi mkhyen te/ ston pa nyi seng bya ba des mdzad na phar/ thogs med kho na mkhas so mkhas so zhes bsgrags nas/ zer zhing log song gsung ngo*/ /'chad nyan gyi gegs su song dogs pa las/ thugs song na tshe dpag med kyi sgrub mchod gcig la ci tshegs te/ lo tsā ba byang rtses/ mkhan chen bu ston pa'i gsung gis/

rdo rje dbyings kyi sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan lhug pa ma dang*/ tshigs bcad ma gnyis ka bzung nas bskyangs pa yin te/ byang du ma 'dod gsung gin gda' zhus pas/ de rang byang po byed pa la/ de tsam gyi rtsol ba med gsung zhing*/ 'phral gyi mig nye dang*/ 'dod yon mthun 'jug ngo bsrungs/ tshul 'chos thams cad spangs te/ rtsi lhong la sogs pa'i gnas dben pa rnams su/ thos bsam dang*/ 'chad nyan shin tu 'phel bar mdzad/ thun mtshams su ri khar byon nas/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ dgongs grib ma byung ba dang*/ nges 'byung dang skyo shas drag po skye zhing*/ de'i mtshan mo rnams zin pa dang*/ dag pa'i zhing khams mang po gzigs pa byung*/ ༈ gzhan la cung zad phan na/ rang gi lus srog la yang ma gzigs par gzhan phan mdzad de/ dgung lo bcu drug tsam bzhes pa'i dus su zang zing gi drin cung zad yod pa gcig gis/ don gal chen gcig la/ sa skyar bang chen la mngags nas/ sang nyin 'khor ba gyis zer/ des chos rje pas byon pas/ lam phyed tsam gyi thang stong gcig na khyi mo gcig la phru gu skyes nas/ bkres pas nyen te phru gu za ba la thug pa gcig 'dug pas/ tshad med pa'i snying rje 'khrungs/ phan pa'i thabs bsams pas/ di ring khyi ma smad e ru bskyal la/ do nub mtshan 'bros bya ba las med snyam du dgongs te/ snying stobs chen pos/ 'thab pa dang*/ ngal ba'i 'jigs pa khyad du bsad nas/ khyi ma bu khur nas tshur bskyal nang du song la/ chu lta bur gcig mthung la 'gro dgongs pa la/ bang chen la gtong ba'i mi de dang phrad pas/ khyed kyis ma phyin nam zer ba la/ de don brjod pas/ don gal can rang gcig yin te/ khyod ka snying rje che ba gcig yod zer nas/ drag po 'thab tu byung bas/ nang du 'gro ma nus par/ de ka nas log te mtshan 'gros mdzad pas/ nang par snga mor don mi dang phrad/ don yang grub nas/ de ma thag byon pas/ er nyi ma'i kha la phebs pas/

mi de yang shin tu dga' zhing dad nas/ khar sang mang po 'thabs te bzod par gsol cig /ngo mtshar che lags zer ro/ /yang dgung lo nyi shu tsam gyi dus su/ e'i btsun pa rnams chos bar la byon pa'i tshe/ rgya sgo'i 'gag na/ sprang mo zha mo gcig yod pa de ngu ba gzigs nas/ khyod ci la ngu dris pas/ btsun pa rnams gzhan du gshegs par 'dug gzhan gyis bdag la ster mi mi yong zer ba la thugs kyi ma bzod de/ sdug bsngal ma byed cig /ngas khyod len du 'ong gis gsungs nas/ chos bar gyi gnas su khur po bskyal nas/ cung zhig ngal gsos te/ thag pa khyer nas byon pas/ grogs po rnams na re gar 'gro zer ba la/ bdag sprang mo de len du 'gro gsungs pas/ bden par mi 'dzin 'dug /sprang mo nga la khur gcig gsungs pas/ 'khur mi nus 'dug nas/ thog mar mo'i gos stan rnams khur nas ring por bskyal/ yang log nas mo khur yong*/ de ltar de mos kyis chos bar gyi sar khur byon pas/ grogs rnams na re/ me shing thur ru 'gro ba yin yong snyam pa yin te/ shin tu ngo mtshar che zer ro/ /dgung lo sum cu tsam gyi dus su/ rgya sgor sdod pa'i sprang po gcig la shig nad drag po byung 'dug pa la/ rje pa rang la gang yod kyi bza' btung rnams mngon tshan chung bar bya ba'i phyir/ mtshan mo bskyal zhing gsos/ nub gcig skyel du byon pas/ kho mi 'dug /mtha' 'khor rnams btsal bas kyang ma rnyed/ nang par snga mo ltar phyin pas rtsig skog gcig na 'dug /'dir sdod pa ci yin byas pas/ mi rnams 'gro 'ong byed dus/ khyod mthong tsa na skyug bro yi 'dug zer nas phud pa yin zer bas/ bzod thabs med pa'i snying rje drag po skyes nas mang po bshums/ 'gro 'ong byed pa kun 'di la mig ma bltas kyang chog pa la snyam pa byung gsungs/ de'i nub mo kho nang du khrid de/ bza' btung gis tshims par byas/ tsar thul gsar pa gcig yod pa kho la byin nas btang*/

kho'i go log kun spos te shig gsos pas/ mdze'am 'brum bu nag po glang gnya' byung ba bzhin song nas chos chag pas/ slob ma dang grogs mched kun gyis sku khams log pa yin nam snyam nas ltar byung bas/ de ltar gyur pa mthong nas/ 'ga' zhig gis/ lar chos pa bzang ba kas chog pas zer zhing 'thab/ la las snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag pas/ / lus 'di btang bar mi bya ste/ /zhes sogs kyi chos bshad byed/ la las/ bdag cag gi slad du 'di ltar mi mdzad du gsol zhes/ nan gyis shig 'dor bar zhus kyang*/ thog med dus nas/ lus ji snyed blangs kyang don med du song 'dug /da res shi yang don can yin pas shig mi 'dor gsungs nas/ shig gsos pas/ zhag bcu bdun tsam nas shig las grol te/ shig ro kun la gzungs sngags mang po bzlas shing tsha tsha btab pas/ kun gyis lhag bsam rnam dag dang ldan par rtogs shing*/ ngo mtshar gyi gnas su 'dzin la/ mtshan yang rgyal sras chen po zhes sa steng thams cad du grags/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas sa skyar spyan drangs/ chos mang po zhus/ tshur res la btsas nag por jag pa byung*/ dngul chur phebs pa dang jag pa rnams kyi don du sman bla dang*/ sgrol gsol la sogs pa mang po mdzad cing*/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur yang ci rigs su mdzad do/ /jag pa'i nang na ma rungs pa'i rnam pa can gcig 'dug pa dran pa tsam gyis bzod thabs med pa'i snying rje skyes gsung ngo*/ /yang sku khams gseng ba'i sar sprang po nam bzang zer ba gcig slong du byung ba la/ phrug cham gcig dang*/ ber thul gcig yod pa'i phrug cham de gnang nas/ brang kang du phebs pa dang*/ khyod ber thul 'di la chags 'dug pa dgongs nas sprang po 'bod du byon pas/ kho'i bsam pa la cham se 'phrog par 'dug bsam bros pa la/ ded nas zin ber thul byin pas khos len mi nus pa 'dra ba 'dug gsung ngo*/ yang dngul chu'i brang khang na bzhugs dus/

sprang po 'ga' zhig gis re mos byas shing yang yang slong ba la/ byung res kyis rtsam pa sder re gnang bas/ khal gsum tsam gyi rtsam pa yod pa nyin gcig la zad/ yang byung res kyis rtsam sgye/ sbud pa/ spyan ra/ phyag phreng rnams re re nas gnang ba la/ sgrub pa po nyi seng gis/ sprang po rnams la/ khong pa rang la'ang tsam phad gang po 'di las med pa la/ khyed rnams ha cang yang mi rig zhes 'thabs so/ /drung pa la de tsam gnang ba/ gsol rgyu mi mchi zhus pas/ ster rgyu yod bzhin phongs pa la mi ster ba mi bzod gda'/ nam kyang mu ges mi 'chi yong*/ shi yang bzod lags gsung ngo*/ /byang da ra nas jag pas brdungs pa'i mi sum cu tsam gyis chos rdzong sgo rtsar slangs pas/ nye gnas med shul na bza' ber thul gcig gnang bas/ 'di gon du mi btub bza' bca' zhu zer bas/ btub kyis gsungs gtubs nas gnang*/ zhib dang rtsing phye gang yod kyang gnang ngo*/ /lha rtse pa'i hor 'dra 'ga' slong du byung dus/ gser dang*/ na bza' gang yod kyang gnang zhing*/ rang gi bde ba yal bar dor nas/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pa kho nas sems can la phan pa 'ba' zhig mdzad do/ khro phu ba tshad ma'i skyes bu la/ sa sde lnga dang*/ rgyas pa 'bum dang*/ brgyad stong pa gsan no/ /'jam dbyangs nyag gcig pa la/ nyi khri la sogs sras yum gyi skor gzhan rnams gsan/ mkhan chen lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i drung du/ sa sde lnga/ theg bsdus bskor gsum/ mngon pa kun las btus/ thub pa'i dgongs rgyan/ rnam bshad rigs pa/ las sgrub pa'i rab tu byed pa/ rten 'brel mdo 'grail/ dbu ma sgom rim gsum/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ gsang 'dus sgrub thabs/ brgyad stong don bsdus/ de'i 'grel pa/ byang chub gzhung lam/ phung po rab byed/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ bsdud pa'i dka' 'grel sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa rnams gsan/ mkhan po spyi bo lhas pa shes rab rgyal mtshan grub bzang po la/

thugs rje chen po skyer sgang ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i lung gsan/ ༈ brag ram pa mkhan po chos rgyal dpal bzang po la/ khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa dang*/ sems nyid ngal gso'i khrid gsan/ bla ma chen po ti shi kun blo la/ thugs bskyed/ spyod 'jug rgyal sras lam bzang rnams gsan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ bla ma mkhas btsun pa/ bla ma shar pa kun dga' bsod nams rnams la/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed gsan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa la sgrol ma'i dbang*/ sa skya pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa/ dbu ma sems bskyed/ dbu ma chen po'i khrid/ sman bla'i mdo chog rjes gnang rnams gsan/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ sgrol ma dang bde chen ral gcig gi dbang*/ bde mchog dril bu skor gsum gyi dbang*/ bde mchog gi mchod phreng*/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa/ sum+bha lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud/ rtag gnyis/ rnam rgyal/ ri khrod/ lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang*/ rnam rgyal bstod pa tsan dra go mis mdzad pa rnams gsan/ bla chen bsod blo pa la/ mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa'i drung du blo sbyong don bdun ma/ smon 'jug sems bskyed/ don zhags bskor/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ sman bla'i mdo chog rjes gnang*/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ ri khrod lo ma can/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs jo bos mdzad pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga /dze ta ris mdzad pa'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi gsol 'debs/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang ba'i rigs gtad rnams gsan/ bla ma kun spangs nam mkha' grags pa la/ dril bu pa'i dbang lan gsum/ bslab btus/ mdo btus la sogs gsan/ bla ma shākya byang chub pa la/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa/ byang chub ltung bshags/ thabs lam 'khor lo bcings grol/ phar phyin gyi bstod gcig rnams gsan/

mkhan chen rin po che bu ston pa la/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje/ bde mchog dril bu pa/ dpal mchog rdo rje sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang dang*/ dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ nag po pa'i sgrub thabs kyi ṭi ka /las chog gi ṭi ka la sogs gsan/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa la ma ṇi'i lung gsan/ bla ma don yod pa'i phyir du/ dbus kyi bde ba can pa slob dpon rgyal po dpal la/ chos skyong gi las tshogs rnams gsan/ bla ma bkra shis mgon la/ mngon pa kun las btus gsan/ slob dpon dpal gyi byang chub la ltung bshags 'don thabs dang 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma bsdus pa gsan/ bla ma blo bzang pa la/ glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma rnams gsan no/ /༈ de nas a ru gug sri rin chen seng ge'i sgrub mchod la/ bla ma kun rgyal ba/ bla ma kun spangs nam mkha' grags/ drung pa rnams 'dzoms pa'i gsung gleng gi 'phros la/ bla ma kun rgyal ba na re/ 'o skol gyi slob dpon rin rgyal ba'ang sku gshegs/ rta ra'i gdan sa pa gcig dgos par 'dug /nyid cag pas bgres pa slob dpon kun dga' dar yang 'dug ste/ tsho 'og na yod pa'i grwa pa bu slob thams cad kyang nyid cag la mos pa shas che bar gda'/ 'chad nyan la sogs gang gi cha nas kyang 'thad cha che bar gda' bas/ slob dpon thogs med pas rta ra'i gdan sa mdzad par zhu gsungs shing*/ rin po che sher 'bum pa'ang dmar khrid 'bogs kyin yod pa'i gsung nas/ khrid nyon gsungs nas/ ma zhus par gnang ste/ da lta zhu ba mang po yong ba 'di la dgongs par 'dug gsungs/ de dus rin po che'i gsung nas kyang*/ bla ma rnam pas zhu phul ba bzhin/ rta ra'i gdan sa 'di mdzad par zhu gsung ba la/ drung pa'i thugs dgongs la/ mi byed zhus na/ nga'i dam tshig la sems la cis kyang byed dgos gsungs byung gis dogs nas/ gang ltar yang nang par zhal ta zhu ru yong bar zhu zhus nas zhal gyis ma bzhes/

de rjes bla ma gnur chos 'phags pa'i drung du byon nas/ bdag la rta ra'i gdan sa byed dgos gsung ba gda' bas/ 'di byed mi dgos pa'i zhal ta mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ ngas rta ra'i bla ma sku mched pa'i drung du phyin la/ khyed la gdan sa byed mi dgos pa'i thabs bya'i gsung du re tsa na/ de shin tu legs/ 'di mi khas byin pa'i gdan sa yin/ nyid cag la 'jig rten pa rnams kyi sems 'dzin dang*/ bya byed mang po ni mi dgos/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje phun sum tshogs pa ni yod/ chos de gza' skar nam bzang gcig la 'dzugs pa lags mdo gsungs pas/ thugs dgongs la/ da byed dgos par 'dug bla ma dkon mchog la blo gtad pas/ gang byas kyang legs par 'ong dgongs nas/ zhal gyis bzhes pas/ bla ma byang sems rin mgon pas gtso mdzad/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ khyad par du shab tshang pa la gtogs pa'i dge bshes grwa pa bu slob rnams kyis zhu 'bul mdzad nas/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa'i stag lo la/ e pa'i zur chen mdzad do/ /dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus la/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston pas mdzad pa'i ṭi ka'i thog nas chos gsungs shing*/ dus phyis spang lo'i ṭi ka la gzhi mdzad nas/ yig cha gsal ba gcig mdzad dgongs na'ang*/ ṭi ka snga ma la gnod kyis dogs nas/ 'grel pa ma mdzad par/ gzhung la 'chan 'ga' re mdzad cing*/ zab pa rgya che bas mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed cing*/ rmongs pa dad pa sad par byed pa'i chos kyi 'brug sgra bsgrags te/ thabs mkhas pa'i mdzad pas/ drung du 'khod pa'i grwa pa/ blo sbyong ba rnams dang*/ rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams par thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi dge ba la sbyor zhing*/ btang snyoms su yud tsam yang yal bar mi 'dor la/ 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gyis phongs pa'i nyam chung rnams kyis rgyags chu ma 'dzoms pa yang*/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i bu slob rnams la 'di'i 'tsho ba sbyor gsung ba'i zhal ta mdzad nas/

gnyis ka dge ba sbyor ba dang*/ drung pa rang 'tsho ba med kyang ston bsod snyoms bcag nas blo sbyong mdzad pas/ bla ma byang sems pa/ khyed bsod snyoms mi mdzad pa gang byed kyi yod gsungs pa la ci yang byed pa mi bdog zhus pas/ 'o na 'tsho ba med/ nged kyi phyi la dngul chur 'gro gsungs pa la/ mi 'gro zhu ba ma nus par byon pas/ nyin mtshan 'dod yon gyis 'da' ba la bla ma'i thugs brtse ba yin na'ang*/ thugs sbyong sogs yon tan ma 'phel bas/ thugs ma bde nas 'gro bar zhus te/ bo dong du phebs shing*/ 'tsho bas phongs kyang chos spyod 'phel bas/ shin tu thugs bde bar byung gsungs pa dang*/ grwa skor ba la rdzong ba mdzad rgyu ma 'byor ba la/ bzhugs gdan dang*/ bla re'i sham bu dras shing gnang ba dang*/ bshad slongs pa byung ba'i dus su nang du bos nas/ ka ca gang dga' gdam la khyer cig gsungs pas/ chos gdan grum tshe cig yod pa zhu zer khyer ba/ slob ma gcig gis ma bzod de/ bslus nas drung du phul/ bro pas gnang sbyin zhus pas/ nang du bos nas/ gang dga' ba cig khyer cig gsungs pas/ gsol sder khyer ba dang*/ dbu zhwa dang*/ na bza' zhabs lhe la sogs ci 'dod sbyin par mdzad pa sogs brjod las 'das shing*/ de dus bsnyung ba gcig byung ba la zhal ta 'dra mi bdog gam zhus pas/ nga'i kha chems rgyal sras lag len yin no gsungs/ dngul chu na ston chos gsung gin bzhugs pa'i dus na/ bla ma don yod pa'i gsung yig byung nas/ e'i bla chos pa mdzad par zhus pa la/ thugs kyis ma long bar/ spang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa sa skya na bzhugs pa'i drung du byon nas/ e'i bla chos la 'byon par zhus pas/ gu ru thogs med/ thos pa'i gtam la snyan/ nga'i bla mas ma thob pa'i gdan sa yin gsungs te/ zhal bzhes byung nas/ bla ma don yod pa sku mched kyi drung du byon te/ bla chos pa bla ma lo tsā ba'i drung du zhu 'bul bar zhu zhus nas/

drung pa rang dben pa la thugs gzhol zhing*/ sgrub pa snying paur mdzad par dgongs pa dang*/ gzhan yang nyams len la bskul ba'i phyir/ kye kye nyon dang grogs po dam pa kun/ / kun kyang gtan gyi bde ba thob 'dod na/ / na rga 'chi dang skye ba'i sdug bsngal bsam/ / bsam pa dag pas sgo gsum dge la 'bad/ / 'bad kyang don chung 'jig rten bya ba spang*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rin chen bzhi las grub pa'i lhun po yang*/ / rab 'bar me dang phrad tshe mig sman gyi/ / ril bu tsam yang lus par mi 'gyur na/ / rul pa'i lus 'di gtan du gnas sam kye/ /zhes pa la sogs pa chos la bskul ba'i gtam rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ rin po che'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ ༈ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bar la 'chad pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ rtsom pa gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad cing*/ mtshan nyid kyi slob ma g.yu chu ba/ slob dpon kun rin zhes pa bka' pod bcu gsum la blo bshad byed pa'i ston bzang dang*/ slob dpon shaka 'byung*/ ye rgyal sogs khyad par mdo sde rgyan la mkhas pa dang*/ rgyal rin/ blo gros mtshungs med sogs mngon pa la mkhas pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs kha che/ slob dpon rdor rin/ bla ma dkon mchog seng ge /spang rtsa paṇa chen la sogs pa'i bka' pod du ma la mkhas pa phul du phyin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po yang*/ slob gnyer mgo legs par ston/ zang zing gi gnang sbyin yang ci rigs su mdzad/ sa sdes gtso mdzad pa'i phyag dpe rnams kyang*/ chos rje lo tsā ba la phul/ thugs dam glegs bam gcig yod pa'ang bla ma gnur chos 'phags pa la phul/ bla ma bkra shis mgon pa la'ang 'bul ba mdzad/ byang sa'i phyag dpe gcig ma gtogs pa'i phyag dpe dang*/ ka ca thams cad spong thad mdzad nas/ glang lo la e pa'i 'chad nyan bshol te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ / bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos gcig de ring rnyed/

/ su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas/ / mi smra nags 'dab dag tu gnas par bya/ /zhes pa'i don thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i phyir dngul chur byon te/ don dam dang kun rdzob kyi sems gnyis kyi sgo nas sgrub pa snying por mdzad cing bzhugs yod pa la/ e pa'i dge bshes dang*/ slob ma rnams kyis/ da dung chos gsung bar zhu ba'i spyan 'dren la byon pas/ brtse yang gzhan phan nus med ma ṇi ba/ / mchi ma'i rgyun dang snying rjes gdong dang yid/ / rnam par brlan par gyur nas rang nyid kyi/ / slob ma rnams la snying gtam 'di skad smra/ / dal 'byor rin chen gling du chud dus 'dir/ / dam chos yid bzhin nor bu mi len par/ / don med tshe 'di'i bya ba lhur blangs na/ / 'gyod kyang 'phyis pa'i dus gcig byung dogs yod/ /ces sogs dang*/ phrad kyang 'di las gzhan pa smra rgyu med/ / shi yang kha chems gzhan 'ga' ma mchis so/ /zhes pa'i gdams pa'i yi ge gnang nas mjal kha yang ma gnang bar/ slar sku mtshams dam par mdzad nas/ thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ mkhan chen bu ston rin po che'i gsung nas/ chos shes la nyams su longs pa rgyal sras thogs med lta bu gcig bya bsam pas/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od pa'i bka' ma chog par/ 'chad nyan byed byed nas/ khong pa'i sgrub pa lta bu ma byung gsungs pa dang*/ spang lo tsā ba'i gsung nas/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung nas/ thog mar shes bya kun la mkhas par bya/ / bar du gdul bya'i tshogs la legs par bshad/ / tha ma 'dris pa'i don la rtse gcig bsgom/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa de/ rgyal sras thogs med khong gis grub 'dug khong la nga 'dra ba'i slob dpon brgya yod de/ nga la khong 'dra ba'i slob ma khong gcig pu las med/ mi phal pa rnams kyis nga'i rgyud tshad sleb pa la bskal pa mang por tshogs bsog dgos par 'dug ste/ ngas khong gi rgyud tshod sleb pa la de bas kyang che mang ba'i tshogs bsog dgos par 'dug gsungs/

spang lo tsā ba bde bar gshegs khar/ bla ma thogs med pa gdan drang lags sam zhus pas/ byang chub sems dpa' de chab la grongs nas phangs gsungs/ chos rje kun mkhyen pas 'di na sangs rgyas mi gzugs can gcig bzhugs pa yin gsungs nas/ rje pa'i gzim khang la phyag mdzad pa dang*/ bla ma rin ye ba rgyal sras pa'i gsung gleng byung dus/ da lta yang 'di lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzhugs pas/ dga' ba bsgom dgos gsung ngo*/ / ༈ bar skabs gcig tu/ dung lung dga' ldan du bla ma kun spangs nam mkha' grags la mjal du byon pas/ chos rdzong gi mkhar lhan byed pa'i zhal ta mdzad cing 'dug /kun spangs pa'i gsungs nas/ 'di 'dra ba'i blo ma khugs cig da mkhar lhan gyis ci byed snyam du ma dgongs/ bed sus chod mi shes gsungs nas lung bstan/ khong pa grongs khar mjal du byon pas/ nyid la zhu don gsum yod pas smin pa gcig zhu gsungs/ grub par bdog na zhal ta len par zhu zhus pas/ grub par yod kyis/ nga ma shi'i bar nyid rtsar na yod na dga' bar 'dug pas bzhugs pa dang*/ nga 'das nas cho ga thugs kyi gang lcogs gcig zhu ba de don gcig yin/ chos rdzong 'di nyid cag bshad nyan mdzad na chos par mdzad pa/ thugs dam mdzad na dben gnas mdzad par zhu ba gcig yin/ bshad nyan thugs dam gang mdzad rung*/ sgang bshongs nas thog phud nas khal bzhi bcu re bdog pa bzhes par zhu gsung ba la/ bsnyung g.yog dang*/ bde bar gshegs rjes gsol ba ci nus 'debs par spro lags/ gzhis ka bdag tu mi 'dzin par zhu/ chos rdzong 'phral bde spyod cing phug bdag tu mi 'dzin par zhus nas/ gzhis ka'i lo gcig gi thog gsol/ kha rag la sogs gnas dben pa gcig tu 'gro snyam pa yin te/ rtain 'brel gyi byed pas 'di kar bsdad gsungs/ de ltar lung bstan thob pa'i dben gnas khyad par can de nyid du/ snying po med pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad spangs nas/

mtshan mo dbu sngas la mi 'jog cing*/ rdo rje lus kyi gnad ma g.yos par/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin la nyin mtshan rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ thugs dam gyi lhas rjes su bzung zhing*/ gzhan gyi sems mkhyen pa'i mngon par shes pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dngos su len nus pa la sogs pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' tshul du 'dug kyang*/ yon tan thams cad sbas pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs la/ mos gus kyi spyan dang ldan pas gzigs pa la/ tshe dpag med kyi dbang bskur mdzad pa'i ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs su/ zhal ras li khri ltar dmar por 'gyur ba dang*/ bgegs skrod pa'i skabs su zhal ras smug nag tu 'gyur zhing*/ thams cad ba spu zing byed pa dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po byang rtses zhal bcu gcig par gzigs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis zhal ras kyi g.yon phyogs na/ khar sa pā ṇi mtshon gang ba gcig mthong ba dang*/ 'jad gnas gsar gyi jo bo la mjal dus/ jo bo dang drung pa gsung gleng mdzad pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs shing chos gsan zhes grags pa dang*/ zhal snga nas/ bdag la de 'dra'i yon tan med gsung ngo*/ / yang chos rje bsod nams grags pa la mjal du byon dus/ shangs mda'i bye ma'i skyibs gcig tu/ ja skol ngal gso gsungs/ zhabs tog pa rnams kyi bsam pa la/ chu shing yod pa gcig tu bzhugs pas chog pa la snyam pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas/ chu ngas khag khur gyi shing tshol gcig gsungs/ shing bsgrugs pas chu 'di na gda' yi gsungs/ phyag gis tud tud mdzad pas sngar med pa'i chu byung bas/ gzhan rnams kyi bsam pa la mig 'khrul ba yin nam snyam pa byung*/ ja bskol nas gshegs dus chu yang skams so/ /de nas chos lung du phebs/ 'jug pa sems bskyed zhus pas/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa'i gsungs nas/ ngas kyang bla ma la dad gus chen po byas nas zhus/

'o skol dam tshig gi sel med pas phan shin tu che/ chos bdag po la 'phrod pa yin gsungs/ mnyes tshor chen po mdzad/ thengs gcig yid la med dus/ nye gnas la ja gcig yod na snyungs rin po che pa la mjal du 'gro snying 'dod gsungs/ blo bur du byon pas/ lam du ho 'dra gcig gis ra gcig khrid byung*/ phyag rten la dmigs pa'i gser zho phyed yod pa hor 'dra la byin nas ra'i srog blus/ rin po che la phyag rten yang med kyang shin tu mnyes/ yun ring du bzhugs par zhu gsungs/ zla byed tsam bzhugs nas byon pas/ ring po ma thogs par/ rin po che pa nyid bde bar gshegs/ rjes nas kyang chos gsung res kyis/ mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa la bdag gis thob pa lag gsungs zhing*/ phyag thal mo sbyor/ spyan chab dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing*/ tshad med pa'i mos pa dang gus pa mdzad nas/ rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin no/ / yang bla ma rin ye ba la mjal du 'gro snying 'dod gsungs nas byon/ zhabs tog la slob dpon dpal ye yod pa la/ nyid drung pa la chos ci zhu gsungs/ dpe chos rin spungs gcig lags byas pas/ 'o na dpe cha khyer gcig gsung*/ dpe cha khong pa rang la yod lags zhus pas/ khyer ba drag gsungs/ bla ma pa la mjal dus khyod tsho la 'dod mos kyi yod gsungs/ khong la dpe chos rin spungs cig zhu ba 'dod gda' na'ang*/ sku khams ltem pas zhu ma nus gda' zhus pas/ dpe cha gzhong mo cher len du btang dgongs gsung ba la/ dpe cha yod zhus pas/ khams kyis nus gsungs nas gnang*/ 'byon khar bla ma pa'i gsung nas/ nga la na tsha drag po 'dug snyam pa'i thugs khral ma mdzad/ 'chi ba lam du 'gro ru re ste/ 'gro mi 'gro cha med nad 'di bas thu ba byung yang lam du 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ cher ma thogs par bde bar gshegs/ yang slob dpon nam mkha' seng ge la/ sku 'gag gcig gnang ba gyon nas ja drangs pa na/ slob dpon bde bzang gi rtog pa la/

nga la'ang sku 'gag gcig gnang na snyam pa byung*/ gnas mal du slebs pa dang*/ sku 'gag gcig skyel du btang byung bas/ ngo tsha ba la tshugs pa med pa byung*/ lo tsā ba nam bzang gis shing tog 'bul ba gcig mthong nas/ bro ba ji 'dra gcig yod dam bsam pa la/ bro ba ji 'dra gcig bdog gam legs po gcig gda'o gsungs/ khong gi mdun du bskyur byung bas/ khong la kha skyengs po gcig byung*/ yang sa chog byed pa'i khro 'bag 'di 'dras/ lha 'dre 'jigs nyen med snyam pa la/ de yin khro 'bag rkyang pas lha 'dre 'jigs nyen med gsungs zhing*/ gzhan gyi sems la shar ba mang po mkhyen/ mkhan po zangs phug pa'i rtog pa la/ gzims mal na dbyi dkar gyi gdan gcig 'dug pa/ 'di nga la yod na snyam pa mkhyen nas/ gdan 'di nyid cag rang gang dga' ba mdzod gsungs gnang bla ma byang rtse pa'i thugs dgongs la/ nga'i 'di rang bden snyam pa gcig byung ba la/ mi la la'i rtog pa la/ nga'i 'di kho na bden bsam pa gcig 'dug ste/ de ka rkyang rkyang yang ma lags gsungs/ slob dpon dpal ye bas/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid zhus pas/ lung du byas pa drag long mi yong gsungs/ bdag la bya rgyu mi bdog long yong lags zhus pas/ glau bur du brel ba ci yong mi shes gsungs pas/ zhag gnyis tsam na/ khong gi spun zla na nas long ma byung*/ bla ma thub pas/ shes rab khri pa dang*/ khri brgyad stong pa zhus/ sdom gsum 'od phreng zhu bsam na yang dngos su zhu ma nus pa la/ de ma thag khyer la shog gsungs nas gnang*/ dpon chen rgyal bzang bzung dus/ phal che ba dpon chen mi thon zer ba la/ dpon chen la cang mi yong gsungs pas/ cher ma thogs par thon/ dpon 'phags pa bzung dus/ zhu 'bul mdzad pas/ khyed la mi chos kyi bcol ba med gsungs byung*/ thar bar dgongs nas drung pa rang gis kyang sgrol ma btson 'don gyi cho ga mdzad/ gnas rnying tshogs pa la sgrol gsol zhus shing*/

btson 'grol gyi cho ga mkhyen pas cho ga mdzad pas thon no/ / bya lo la/ 'jad du yar lung pa'i dmag byung*/ drung pa e na bzhugs pa dngul chur spyan drangs pas/ nga dag yong bas chog ste mi thub pa 'dra gsungs/ 'khrug pa snga ma byang pa rgyal nas/ da dus bde bar yong zer ba la da dung dus bde mo mi yong*/ thams cad dngos po la ma chags par bros/ 'gro ba mi yong ba'i rgan rgon gyi g.yog ngas bya yi/ ston pa zla bzang rang yang er bzhud gsungs pas/ phal che ba bsdad pas/ yar lung pa rgyal nas/ dngul chu ba yang bcom pas/ drung pa la thugs shes mnga' bar 'dug pas zer zhing*/ mi rnams skrag nas/ drung du 'khor ba na der dmag mi byung ba rnams/ gri mdung khrag gos pa rnams skras bsham du bzhag byung bas/ slob dpon nyi ma mgon pa la sogs skrag pa la/ kho pa na re/ khyed bla ma'i drung na bzhugs pa rnams skrag mi dgos zer nas/ drung du byin rlabs zhu ba dang*/ 'ga' re ngas mi bsad pas bla ma la grib yong*/ byin rlabs zhu ba mi nus zer ba la/ grib byung yang bzod gsungs nas byin rlabs mdzad/ bsrung dar gnang bas/ 'ga' re mchi ma 'byin zhing*/ gsol 'debs dang*/ bshags pa byed pa byung ngo*/ /tshad med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis/ khro zhing gtum pa'i sems can ma rungs pa rnams kyang*/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rgyud la bslan nas/ gnod pa'i bsam pa ngan pa rnams phan bde'i sems su bsgyur bar mdzad cing*/ phag lo la/ 'jad du dmag byung dus/ dmag 'grim pa'i sum cha tsam gzigs pas/ snying rje'i shugs drag po 'khrungs nas dran med du yun ring po song*/ de phyin chad dran med du 'gro ba ci rigs byung*/ yang bla ma rgya ma pas/ mtshams khongs su rgyal sras pa'i 'dul ba rgyud la bstod pa gcig brtsams pas/ de tshar tsam na/ khyed kyis brtsams pa'i 'dul ba rgyud kyi phyag 'tshal de bskur gsung ba byung bas/ rgya ma pa la'ang*/

thogs pa med par gzigs shing yod par 'dug bsam/ 'jigs la nyams dga' ba zhig byung ngo*/ / chags sdang la sogs tshe 'di'i chos brgyad kyi rtog pa las grol ba ni/ sa skyar 'khrug pa byung nas/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched dbus su 'gro dgos pa byung bas/ bla ma rin ye bas/ rje pa la/ 'di 'dra'i mi rig pa byung dus/ bdag la gnyen pos zin tsam byung ste/ chags sdang gi rtog pa mang po skye bar gda'/ nyid cag la ji 'dra byung gsungs pas/ rje pa'i gsung nas/ spyir 'jig rten pa'i bde sdug la sogs thams cad las las grub pa'i sems snang yin pa dang de nyid kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ don dam byang sems kyi go ba ra ri zhig bdog pas/ bdag la chags sdang gi rnam rtog ma skyes lags/ zhes gsung ngo*/ / ༈ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dngos su len nus pa ni/ slob dpon dpal ye la shig nad byung ba/ drung pas gzigs pas/ blangs nas nub mo spyan sngar slebs pa'i tho rangs khong gi shig nad drag nas/ drung pa la 'phos pa dang*/ dar sdings pa'i mi zhig gi mig na ba la/ sha phyed/ ja zho phyed/ gtor byed cig phul nas gtor ma zhus/ mig nad dngos su blangs nas drag mkhan chen bu ston rin po che ba snyung dus/ g.ya' bzangs lha rje la sogs pas bcos kyang ma phan pa gsan nas/ drung pas blangs pas snyung gzhi dwangs mkhan chen byang rtse pa la/ gsol gyi ro ma thu mo yod pas/ dmigs pas blangs pas/ khong pa'i snyung ba dwangs/ der gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad dngos su lon pa gda' lags zhus pas/ dmigs pa gang gtad de lon par gda' ste/ snying rus chung bas bsran par mi nus gda' gsungs/ ma gcig gzhon nu 'bum snyung dus dbang zhus pas/ gtong len mdzad pa dang snyung ba dwangs/ snying rje byung rgyal du btang nas/ nyin mtshan khor mar de nyid la rtse gcig tu 'byams nas/ gzhan gyis rgyal ba ltar mthong zhing*/ thugs bzod med sems can gyi dbang du song bas so/

/ ༈ dai nas chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa gong du gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pa dharmā kīrtis spyan drangs te/ sa skyar byon pas/ gong ma'i gnang sbyin rnams phul/ chos zhus pas/ kho yang dad nas/ khyed ban dhe rnams la rang rang gi yi dam dang*/ dge sbyor gtso 'di la byed zer ba 'dug /bla ma yi dam dang*/ thugs dam gang la gtsor mdzad zhu ba la/ thugs rje chen po la yi dam byas nas/ ma ṇi bgrang ba min pa/ gzhan ci yang mi shes gsungs/ yang khos se chen rgyal po'i/ sa skya paṇa chen khu dbon yon mchod du 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad nas/ de'i gdan sa pa la bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa byon na/ bstan pa'i dar rgyas/ sems can la phan bde 'byung ba'i thugs dgongs khyad par can/ khyed bod kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gshen rnams la mnga' bar yod pa bzhin/ gong ma chen pos sgrub pa yin pas/ bla ma gdan 'draungs pa'i thabs la 'byon dgos/ khyed bla ma'i yang bla mar 'dug khyed kyi bka' bla mas mi gcog pa yin zer bas/ ngas zhu ba la sogs kyang mi shes pa'i sprang po bya bral ba yin/ don med lung stong 'grim pa la dgos pa med gsungs pas/ kho na re/ bla ma khyed ci yang mi mkhyen na/ nyin re bzhin ban dhe mang po la chos bshad pa ci yin/ sprang po bya bral ba bya ba gnas nges med 'grim pa la zer ba yin/ ci nas kyang 'byon dgos zer yang*/ zhal bzhes ma mdzad pas/ kho na re/ nged kyang bla ma gdan ma 'drongs bar la sdod/ nyin re bzhin sems can mig che re ba brgya re tsam gsod pa 'di snying mi rje ba e yin/ khyed gar bzhugs kyang sems can gyi don las med/ nged hor rnams kyang sems can yin mod/ thugs rje re chung zer bas/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje 'khrungs/ spyan chab dpag tu med pa byon/ chos rje pa gong du 'byon rung mi 'byon rung*/ thag snga bar chod na/ hor rnams nyin gcig gis 'degs pa snga na'ang sems can la phan par 'dug ste dgongs nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan pas/

dbus phyogs su zhu phul ba dang*/ jo bo la mjal ba dang*/ dbus phyogs su gzhan phan rgya chen 'byung ba la dgongs nas/ 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ de bar la sa skya'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga la sogs pa chos mang du gsungs/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun pa glang gi lo la/ 'gro ba mang po la phan par gzigs nas/ dbus phyogs su byon zhing lha sa dang*/ tshal gung thang la sogs par/ ta'i si tu dge legs bzang po pas bdag rkyen mdzad nas/ gsang phu la sogs dgon sde mang po nas byon pa'i/ mtha' yas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing*/ rims nad 'dug pa rnams kyang*/ chos rje dbus su phebs pas rgyun chad/ 'chi nges pa'i btson ma mang po yang thar bar mdzad/ 'bul ba rgya chen po byung ba rnams kyang*/ dpal sa skyas gtso byas dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams su mang ja/ 'bul ba 'chad nyan sgrub pa rnams la gnang zhing*/ chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ dbus su sngar ni ma byon kyang*/ mar res ri spungs su phebs dus/ ri 'di'i pha chag na/ rong ngur smrig gi sgrol ma rang byon bzhugs gsung ba dang*/ yang bsam yas kyi thad kyi nam mkha' la phyag mdzub btsugs nas/ pha gi na su yod gsungs/ bsam yas bdog zhus pas/ de'i tshod yin/ ngo mtshar che/ khyed rang rnams kyang phyag tshol gsungs/ drung pa dbu zhwa phud nas/ yan lag bdun pa dang smon lam mang du mdzad/ khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang du/ 'di kun lha sa bas kyang byin rlabs che gsungs/ zhag 'ga' skor ba sha stag mdzad/ bsam yas byang chub chen po la mjal dus/ me tog gi char chen po babs/ spang lo tsā ba'i gsung nas/ lha sa'i jo bos kyang mtshar ba zhig yod gsung ba bden par 'dug gsungs nas/ mos gus kyi gdung bas spyan chab mang po byon/ thugs bskyed rang gis len pa la sogs chos spyod mang du mdzad/

yar lung bsam gtan gling du lo bzhi bzhugs/ dpon dbang gis brang khang nor dang bcas pa phul/ si tu byang rgyal bas zhabs tog dang 'bul ba rgya chen po byas/ chos mang du gsungs so/ /gung thang nas/ lha sar byon dus/ dpon slob 'ga' zhig chu bar phyogs su thon/ lhag ma rnams ko ba la sgrol gyin yod pa'i rjes na tshur/ mi gcig gis rta bdun ded nas rkyal btang byung bas/ chu dkyil du gar song cha med du nub song ba/ drung du zhus pas/ a ka kha gzhan bya rgyu med/ sgrol ma thon gsungs/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas/ 'phags ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol ma gsungs nas/ spyan chab nyi li li 'dug pas/ yud gcig nas rta byin po thon byung*/ mi de rta dang bral nas/ chus khyer song bas chos rje pa'i sku rgyab nas/ sngar med pa'i mi gzugs ring ba/ phrug gos dkar po gon pa dres ma'i ske rags bcings pa zhig /ngas 'gro ngas 'gro zer/ chu la tshab tshub med par song nas/ chus khyer ba'i mi de'i lag pa nas bton pas ma shi /mi de su yin nam/ ja ldud dgos tshol gsung btsal bas ma rnyed lags zhus pas/ ji tho dod gsungs/ drung pas 'phags ma la gsol ba btab pa'i srung ma yin mchi lags zhus pas/ yin pa'ang srid dam/ de re mtshar cig byung rang gis blo gtod nus na/ dkon mchog 'di rang gis mi bslu nges pa yin gsungs/ de nas jo bo rin po che'i drung du phebs/ me tog gi char mang po babs/ yun ring du gsol ba btab/ si tu dge legs bzang po la nyid cag chos rgyal chen po'i brgyud pa yin pas/ chabs srid thams cad phan bdes skyong ba dang*/ khyad par 'chad nyan pa rnams kyi bdag rkyen mdzad pa dang*/ nyes pa can tshar bcad par 'os pa rnams rang 'dod med pa'i tshar gcod dang rjes 'dzin mdzad par zhu/ gsung ba'i zhal ta mdzad pas zhabs spyi bor blangs nas gsung bzhin sgrub par zhal bzhes mdzad/ jo bo rje man chad dbus phyogs su byon pa'i mkhas grub rnams la/

chos rjai pa nyid kho na gzhan phan che zhes 'ga' zhig gleng zhing*/ dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchi ma byung zhing gsol 'debs cho nge'i sgra chen po dang bcas te/ skyel thung rgyang ring du mdzad nas/ gtsang phyogs la byon/ bshul lam rnams su yang sems can mang po phan bde la bkod nas/ yos lo la/ dben gnas dngul chur phyag phebs so/ / yang bo dong er sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i dbyar gcig char pa ye ma byung bar kun re thag chad/ mu ge'i 'go tshugs pa la/ chen po dpal rgyal bas char 'bebs pa'i zhu ba phul nas bo dong jo bo'i drung du byon te gsol ba btab pas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du char gyi rgyun ma chad par babs te/ thams cad yid sos/ drung pa rang yang mnyes tshor chen po mdzad/ jo bo'i drung du mos gus tshad med pas phyag mang po mdzad/ spyan chab mang du byon/ tshe 'di'i lhad khris spu tsam yang med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ dgung lo bdun cu pa/ sbrul lo zla ba lnga pa nas/ dngul chu'i chos rdzong du brtan par sku mtshams kho na la bzhugs shing*/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse bas kun nas bslangs pa'i byang chub kyi thugs dang chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab zab mos/ thabs shes rab zung du rnam par 'brel ba'i thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pas lung dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pas thugs rgyud yongs su gang bar mdzad do/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bas gtso mdzad pa'i/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa du ma dang*/ gzhan yang*/ dpon chen dang*/ mi chen/ skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'i mgon skyabs dang*/ 'dren pa dam pa mdzad cing*/ ston zla ba gsum sku mtshams gsengs nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos gsungs pas/ gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i nges 'byung dang*/

skyo shas bskyed cing*/ gnod lan du phan pa sgrub pa dang*/ ri khrod du sgrub pa'i dam bca' len pa dang dge ba'i bya ba'i dam bca' len pa dang*/ sdig pa byas pa rnams kyang bshags pa byed/ gnad nas 'dzin cing phyin chad mi byed par sdom pa dang*/ khyim pa rnams kyang bsnyen gnas dang yi ge drug pa'i sgom bzlas dang*/ srog gcod sdom pa dang*/ khyi ra sdom pa la sogs pa'i dge ba la sbyor zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis byin brlabs kyis nye 'khor gyi bya dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ khyi la sogs pa rnams kyang gcig la gcig mi 'tshe zhing*/ byi las bya mthong dus kyang*/ mi gsod kyi steng du slar 'grogs kyis dogs nas dogs zon chen pos phyogs gzhan pa gzur 'gro ba dang*/ rna ba yang bag phab nas chos nyan cing gsol ras dang maṇ+ḍal gyi me tog za ba dang*/ zhabs la ldag cing*/ sku la bsnyes nas nyal sdod pa dang*/ rna mos khyi rnams la brdung kyang khyis rna mo la gnod pa mi byed pa dang*/ sgom chen pa gcig smyau nas gcer bur lag pa gnyis su rdo bzung nas tshogs pa'i gseb tu rgyug yong ba la/ rna mos brgyugs nas brdungs pas/ dran pa rnyed de smyau ba sangs pas/ da res kyi gegs sel rna mos byas kyi gsungs/ rna mo 'dis chos rje pa snyung ba'i dus su yang mya ngan gi rnam pa mang du byas shing*/ bde bar gshegs rjes zhag gsum nas gzims khang gi 'og phyogs gcong rong la lcebs te shi'o/ /sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid gang bzhugs pa'i gnas de yang byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu las grub pas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod thams cad char bzhin du 'bab/ dad pa dang nges 'byung ngang gis skye/ nyams dga' zhing*/ dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel la/ tha na yul sprang thams cad kyang 'grangs shing skyid/ sa phyogs thams cad kyang bde zhing chos dar ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na yang zhing g.yo zhing bde ba nas bde bar sems can gyi don mdzad do/

/thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba 'ba' zhig la sbyor bas/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan par mdzad pas/ po ta la dang mtshungs so zhes bstod par byed la/ chos gsung ba'i dus thams cad du yang*/ me tog gi char 'bab cing khyad par skyes rabs dang*/ spyod 'jug gsung ba'i dus su/ me tog gi char 'di ltar gda' zhus pas/ 'di gang zag la yong ba ma yin/ chos la yong ba yin gsung ba la/ khams pa zhig na re/ chos la yin na ngas spyod 'jug bshad tsa na mi yong ba ci yin zer zhing*/ chos rje nyi gzhon pa'i gsung nas/ rgyal sras pa spyod 'jug nam gsungs kyang*/ bzod le'i skabs su me tog gi char nges par 'bab gsung ngo*/ /de lta bu'i sems dpa' chen po de nyid/ ser sna'i dri ma spangs shing lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba'i sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong ba la goms pa'i stobs kyis/ don chen por 'gyur na sku lus kyang bdag tu mi 'dzin na/ longs spyod lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti/ snyan grags la sogs pa thams cad sgyu ma tsam du rtogs par gsal te/ slob dpon dpal ye shes/ drung gi phyag rdzas gzhan gyis bag yangs su spyod pa 'di ya nga bar gda' bas/ dam zhag cung zad mdzad nas gzhan la phan pa'i thabs su mi 'gro lags sam zhus pas/ bdag gi longs spyod rnams la gzhan gyi blo/ / gzhan gyi nor snyam cung zad mi sems shing*/ / rang gi nor la som nyi ma mchis ltar/ / bag yangs dag tu len cing spyod par shog/ces pa 'di yang brjod cing*/ cung zad spyod pa mthong ngam thos pa na/ / mthu'am 'jab bus bdag gi nor khyer de/ / dpal 'byor phun tshogs chog shes blo dang ldan/ / 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag la longs spyod de/ / longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dpal 'byor myur thob shog /ces bde ba'i rgyur bsngos pas/ gzhan la gnod par mi 'gyur ram snyam/ stag gis mchong sar was mi mchong kyang*/ chos rje 'jam gsar gyi gsung nas/

kho bos cung zad bdag tu ma bzung bas/ rang re'i bla brang gi longs spyod kun sus khyer yang ma byin len du mi 'gro gsung ba dang*/ chos rje rgod tshang ba/ kha che paṇa chen la sogs dngos po bre gang yang mi 'dzin pa mdzad gda' ba bzhin byed lo byas pas/ bdag gi longs spyod sus khyer yang nyes par mi 'gyur/ slar yang phan bde'i rgyur 'grau la re gsungs/ nye gnas rnams la'ang zhal ta 'dra mdzad bya ba 'di dang 'di lta bu sgrub pa'i zhal ta thugs la btags na zhus pas/ chos rje yang dgon pa'i gsung nas/ 'phya rung smon rung khrig chags shig gsung ba bzhin 'grub par mi 'dug na'ang*/ rang res kha ta byas kyang khrig kha yong ba'i nges mi gda'/ thams cad phun sum tshogs pa zhig bya bsam pa len pa dag med de/ sgrub pas 'grub pa'i nges pa mi gda'/ gang byung gi mdun ma mdzad gsung zhing*/ tshul 'chos dang sems rnam par spangs te/ srid pa'i 'dun pa med pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po dang ldan pas/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba cung zad kyis kyang ma gos la/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas/ rkyen ngan pas kyang mi 'khrugs pa'i bzod pa dang ldan zhing*/ sku la gnod pa byas kyang khong khro ba dang*/ 'khon du 'dzin pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' la/ rtogs ldan rte'u 'bul bas/ mtshams khongs su chos rdzong la 'dzegs nas byung ba dang*/ sa skyar gser yig pas gdan drangs dus/ gser yig pa dang bar du phra ma bcug nas/ rje pa'i thugs dang 'gal ba chen po byas/ dus phyis khong dngul chur byung*/ nye gnas kyis rte'u 'bul ba yang slebs gda' zhus pas/ rjes de ma yong na snyam pa zhig 'khrungs/ de ma thag ngas gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bcas yod/ kho byung ba la ci'i phyir mi dga'/ da ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar tsar sdod kyang*/ khong rang ci dga' byed du gzhug dgos dgongs pa zhig byung gsungs/ de'i lo/ sku mtshams grol ma thag

khos kyang mjal nas sngar gyi bshags pa byas shing*/ phyin chad chos 'dun byed par dam bcas so/ /de lta na yang*/ kho ha cang ltogs 'dod cher byed pa gzhan gyis ma theg par/ 'di 'dir sdod du ma bcug pa drag zhus pas/ kho yang blo skyed 'don mchi/ bdag gis kyang blo'i 'phen pa zhig song bdog gsungs/ kho ci dga' byed du 'jug cing*/ dbang po dang 'tshams pa'i chos dang zang zing gi phan 'dogs rgya chen po mdzad do/ / gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ / bde ba'i byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'brel tshad don ldan yin no/ /dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang*/ snyoms las kyi sgyid lug spangs nas/ bying rgod dang*/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral zhing*/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i shes rab kyis/ gang zag dang chos su 'dzin pa las grol zhing*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs khong du chud pa'i skyes mchog de nyid kyis mdo rgyan/ rgyud bla/ spyod 'jug rnams kyi 'grel pas thog drangs pa'i/ bla ma'i bstod pa/ yi dam gyi bstod pa/ gang zag so so la gdams pa la sogs/ tshig re rna bar thos pas dad pa dang nges shes skyai ba'i brtsams chos kyang mang du mdzad do/ / ༈ rin po che 'di nyid kyi nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ tho rangs kyi cha la bla ma'i rnal 'byor tsha gong du phyag gsum brgya de tsam mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i thugs bskyed mdzad/ dkar gtor cha bzhi/ chab gtor klu gtor/ dzaṃ bha la'i chu sbyin rnams mdzad tshar rjes sman bla tshar re/ bhai ṣa dz+ye brgya rtsa/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ g.yug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi/ mi g.yo ba drug cu/ sgrol gtor nyer gcig /brul gtor/ yum sgrub/ kun rig gi cho ga rgyas pa'am/ mdor bsdus du ga ti brgya rtsa/

sgrol ma nyung mtha' nyer gcig re/ ma ṇi khri tsho gnyis re/ bskor ba brgya rtsa tsam re/ bzang spyod/ byams pa'i smon lam/ smon lam bdun cu pa/ sems can mgu ba'i tshigs bcad/ spyod 'jug gi yan lag bdun pa dang bsngo ba/ chos brgyad lam slong*/ gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' dang smon lam/ bde mchog dril bu ba'i mngon rtogs/ bdag 'jug snying po stong phrag re mchod pa'i rjes la sgrol ma tshar bdun re ma chag par mdzad/ mtshan mo sems can la thugs rje dpag tu med pa 'khrungs dus/ bla ma dkon mchog la/ gdung shugs drag po'i gsol 'debs mang du mdzad cing*/ gtso cher mtshan ma med pa'i don/ stong nyid snying rje'i ngang la skad cig kyang ma g.yos par bzhugs nas/ rnal yang ched du mi mdzad cing*/ lus gnad mi 'chug par krong nge ba de ka la bzhugs/ mdor na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras po/ 'gro ba'i bla ma 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ rin po che nyid kyis mdzad pa'i/ dal 'byor gru chen rnyed dka' thob dus 'dir/ /bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir/ /zhes sogs nas/ rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len sum cu bdun/ /rgyal sras lam la slob 'dod don du bkod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan yod pas/ rjes 'jug rnams kyang de ltar nyams su len pa gal che'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa tha ma/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa ni/ bya lo zla ba gnyis pa nas snyung ba'i tshul bstan cing*/ nyin cig slob dpon nam seng la/ brgyad stong pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dang*/ chos 'phags kyi le'u sgrogs shig gsungs/ bsgrags pas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thob tshul gyi skabs na/ nged kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di rnams kyi ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin la bltas na/ gang mnyam par bzhag par bya ba'am/ byang chub tu spyod pa'am/

gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba'i chos de yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo*/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin te/ zhes pa'i skabs su de yin gsungs nas/ da dung nged kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di dag gi ngo bo nyid ces pa man chad thon gsung*/ de nyid bskyar nas zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams so/ /da bsgrags 'tshal lam zhus pas/ da dung thon gsungs nas yongs su rdzogs par bton to/ /zla ba bzhi pa nas/ sku shed med par gyur pas/ lha rje bos nas sman zhig bsten na zhus pas/ khyed tsho mi nyan pa min na/ legs par gsang nas/ sus kyang ma tshor bar shi ba zhig byed pa yin te gsungs/ de ltar bgyis na/ zhabs drung na yod pa rnams kyis gsol sman bsten pa la sogs pa'i zhu ba gang yang ma byas zer/ khag yong lags zhus pas/ 'o na lha rje bos gsungs nas/ phyag rtsa bstan te/ gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pas phyag phebs pa la lta rgyu mi bdog mchi/ 'on kyang zla re tsam ma shi na'ang dge sbyor thun re tsam yong bar gda'i gsungs nas/ se 'bru'i sbyor ba tsam gsol bar gnang*/ bla ma byang rtse ba dang*/ chos rje nyi gzhon pas mjal nas sku khams kyi zhu ba mdzad pas/ 'bras re dang ja 'di 'thung nas mnyam par bzhag pas/ rig pa dwangs la dge sbyor 'phel ba/ nad pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig bdog gsungs/ thams cad kyis sku'i rim gro rgya che la yun ring ba dang*/ gdan bzhugs dang*/ yan lag bdun pa phul nas/ gsol ba btab pas/ sku khams dwangs nas/ slob dpon nam seng la/ khar tsang nas khams ngan pa zhig byung ste/ dge sbyor shin tu 'phel bar byung gsungs/ yang*/ zla ba bdun pa nas cung zad snyung nas/ ston pa zla bzang la/ dge slong nam bzang bos la/ dkon brtsegs 'don pa dang*/ sman bla dang*/ sgrol mchod byed du chug cig gsungs/ snyung g.yog la slob dpon dpal ye/ slob dpon nam seng*/

bla ma rgya ma pa/ bla ma byang rtse ba/ ston pa zla bzang la sogs pa drung na yod pa rnams kyis/ drung gi snyung ba 'di/ gzhi ma ci lags/ dus nam byung lags zhus pas/ gzhi ma drang srong gi nad yin/ byung nas lo sum cu tsam song*/ dang po mkhan po gad phur bas bcos pas/ lo bcu'i bar tsam bde bar byung*/ de nas lo re zhing na zhing*/ khyad par dbus nas 'khor rjes dgun re bzhin shin tu na bar byung*/ na tshul yang du ma zhig byung gsungs/ sngar bcos thabs ci mdzad lags zhus pas/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab nas/ bdag na ba sems can la phan na na bar/ shi ba sems can la phan na shi bar/ sdug pa sems can la phan na sdug par bde ba sems can la phan na bde bar byin gyis rlobs zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab cing*/ gang byung yang*/ dkon mchog gi byin rlabs su blo thag bcad nas/ de la dga' ba sgom zhing lam du 'khyer lo byas pa las/ thabs gzhan ma bgyis gsungs/ da res bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi don du/ phan pa'i thabs shig bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas/ na so mthar phyin cing*/ nad kyang lcid ches pas/ sman pa 'tsho byed bsten zhing*/ sman bdud rtsi 'thung kyang gso ba dka' la/ gal te phan par kyang snang yang mi btsun par 'jug pa la/ rang btsun pa byed dgos zer ba bzhin/ bdag gzhan sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di/ / na na na ste na bas dga'/ / sngar bsags kyi las ngan 'dzad pa yin/ / chos spyod kyi bya ba sna tshogs kyang*/ / sgrib gnyis sbyong ba'i ched du yin/ / na ba med na med de dga'/ / lus sems bde na dge sbyor 'phel/ / mi lus don can byed pa yang*/ / sgo gsum dge la sbyor ba yin/ / 'byor pa med na med de dga'/ / bsrung bsral gyi bya brel de la med/ / 'thab rtsod kyi khro 'khrug ji snyed pa/ / 'dzin chags kyi nor las byung ba yin/ / 'byor pa yod na yod de dga'/ / bsod nams kyi dge tshogs spel bas chog

/ 'phral phugs kyi phan bde ji snyed pa/ / bsod nams kyi 'bras bu yin par nges/ / myur du shi na shi bas dga'/ / rkyen ngan gyis bar du ma chod cing*/ / mtshams sbyor gyi bag chags bzang 'grogs pas/ / ma nor gyi lam du tshud par nges/ / yun du gson na gson pas dga'/ / nyams myong gi lo thog skyes pa la/ / gdams ngag gi brlan drod ma yal bar/ / yun du bsten pas smin par 'gyur/ / gang byung yang dga' ba sgoms shig ang*/ /zhes pa'i/ gang byung dga' ba sgom gyi man ngag 'di/ gzhan la yang bstan na nyams su len lo byed/ rang res nyams su len 'tshal bas rang sor glod nas phan pa'i thabs mi 'tshol zhing*/ don dam shes bya'i gshis la/ nad ces bya ba grub pa med la/ kun rdzob tsam du na ba 'di rgyu 'bras bslu med/ snang ba bden med/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa/ chos shan rkyen gyis 'byed cing*/ sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs khyad par can yin pas/ spang du mi btub/ shi yang gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*/ khyad par byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba 'di 'dra ba 'dzoms pa'i 'chi ba/ phal gyis rnyed pa dka' yang*/ dkon mchog bka' drin la brten nas kho bos rnyed pas na/ sos par re ba'i 'dun pa mi byed 'di tsam du gnas pa yang khyed rnams kyi rim gro'i mthu yin gsungs/ da rung sku rim lo gsum gyi bar du sgrub lags zhus pas/ khyed la phan na sdug pa bzod kyang*/ sdug tshe 'di ring bas ci zhig bya gsungs/ nyi ma'i gung la gnyid la phan par gda' yis/ mgur ma la sogs gang spro gyis shig gsungs pas/ ma byas na ni gsung bcag par 'gyur la/ byas na yun ring bshums byung nas/ drung nas bshums pas 'jigs par gda' lags zhus pas/ 'pho ba yang ched kyis sgom dgos pa yin na/ mgur ma zab po dang*/ nges 'byung chen po skyes pa 'di 'dra ba'i 'phro la shi na rang legs pa yin gsungs/ nyin zhig drung pa zhal thon mdzad cing bskor ba mdzad pas/

sku shed med pas zhabs 'khor ba dang*/ gsung 'dar ba dpags pas bla ma rgya ma pa'i rtog pa la/ da ni mtshan bcas la sogs pa'i dge sbyor 'chag med yod na'ang*/ nged rnams la bcol nas ma mdzad na yong bar 'dug ste bsam ma thag /zhal phyir la 'khor mdzad phyag gnyis kyi phyag phreng bzung*/ thal mo ya gcig brkyangs nas/ da lta ma labs na brjed 'gro de ring nas nga'i tshab bla ma pas gyis la/ nyin re yum sgrub tshar re mdzod/ sgrol ma tshar nyer gcig de'i dam bca' yod pa slob dpon nam bzang la bcol yod/ rang res mi nus par 'dug /ma ṇi la sogs gzhan pa rnams nga rang gis yong bar 'dug khyed gnyis la chos kyi 'bul ba byed pa yin no gsungs pas/ thugs shes kyis mkhyen 'dug bsam/ nges shes skyes shing*/ kha skyengs po tshad med cig byung*/ bla ma byang rtses mjal nas brtan bzhugs dang*/ gsol 'debs mdzad nas/ cung zad gsol gda' ba dang*/ seng tsam byung yang*/ drung pa rang bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun mi mdzad par thugs sna stung ba la/ jo nang ba'i sgrub pa po rlung ltas rtags po yod zer ba zhig na re/ dngul chur sems dpa' chen po snyung ba la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis rten 'brel phyogs gcig tu bsgrig dgos par 'dug cing*/ khyad par du drung pa rang gis zhing 'dir bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad na gsol ba thebs tsam 'dug ste/ skyes mchog chen po khong pa rang bzhugs pa'i thugs dgongs mi 'dug pas/ sku rim yang gal che ste/ de bas kyang drung pa rang gi rten 'brel gtso che zer ba thos nas/ drung du zhus pas/ 'o na rlung ltas kyang re rtags yod par 'dug /nga rang la sdod pa'i rtsis ye med de/ phyogs ris kyi rim gro 'di rnams kyis da bar 'chir ma bcug zer ba la/ de lta bu'i gsung mi 'byon par/ sku tshe byin gyis brlab par zhus pa/ da dung de ka yin gsungs nas/ zhu ba bzhes su ma gnang*/ nyi ma gnyis sku bskyed du mngon tsam byung nas/

bla ma rgya ma pas/ dor zhag sku skyed dum byung gda'/ bdag cag sa skyar chabs gcig 'gro lags zhus pas/ bskyed 'dis grul mi thub/ da lta nang na yod pa 'di rnams/ nga ma shi bar la bzhugs gcigayun ring 'grogs mi dgos par gda'/ dge slong nam bzang dang*/ slob dpon dpal ye la'ang de skad byas bdog gsungs/ nyin zhig rnal bsrung ba'i phyir/ khyoms tsho sna tshogs zhus pa'i 'phro la/ sgom chen 'ga' zhig gi sems kyi rtog pa mkhyen bzhin du dri ba mdzad pas/ bla ma rgya ma pa'i thugs dgongs la/ thugs shes thogs med mnga' bar 'dug bsam nges shes khyad par can skyes/ nyin zhig sman bla'i cho ga gyis gsungs nas/ skad ches na sku khams la gzan gyis dogs/ chung chung byas te/ yid cung zad gzhan du yengs pa'i skabs su/ skad med pa'i nam me nom me ci yin cha med de 'dra byed pa min/ da lta sgom chen pa rnams gsol 'debs re tsam byed tsa na/ mchi ma byung ma byung gi lan gtong*/ phyag mchod la sogs pa'i dus su gleng brjod mi gtong bar 'dug ste/ gsol 'debs rkya la mchi ma 'don dgos rgyu med/ spros med mnyam bzhag la rtse gcig tu 'gro na ni rab yin pas des chog /de ma yin par mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyor gang byed kyang*/ yid kyis sems can gyi sdug bsngal la rtse gcig tu dmigs nas/ de la mi bzod pa cher bskyed pa'am/ yang na/ bla ma dkon mchog gi yon tan la dmigs nas/ de la dad pa dang mos pa rtse gcig tu dungs pa byas nas/ de gnyis nam byed kyang lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba/ mig nas mchi ma 'byung ba/ spyod lam zungs mi thub pa tsam song song gi bar du/ rig pa 'jur mig nas drangs nas/ blo de lta bu'i sgo nas phyag dang skor ba dang*/ mdo 'don/ bzlas brjod la sogs gang byed kyang*/ skad gsang mthon po lam lam pa byed pa de/ rten 'brel snying po'i man ngag dang 'dra bas/ lus kyis ngag gcun ngag gis yid gcun/

zer ba der 'gro bas na/ de bzhin mdzod la cho ga gyis mdzod/ de ma yin par rig pa la ngar ma ston/ sems gzhan du yengs nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod brjod skyabs su mchi'o byas pa la dgos pa tsam med gsungs/ skad ches na snyan snyung gis dogs pa lags zhus pas/ snyan snyung rgyu ci yod/ gnyid bsrung ba'i don du khyoms tsho sna tshogs byed cing*/ ngag 'khyal don med sna tshogs lab pa dang khyad che/ 'o na sems yengs pa'i cho gas kyang snyan mi snyung ba la phan gsungs/ drung pa rang ni/ mtshan bcas kyi rim pa gang mdzad kyang*/ spyan chab phyung zhing*/ snying rje gcig gi shugs drag po dang bcas nas mdzad la/ snyung ba yun ring song sku shed med kyang*/ phyag mchod dang skor ba yid kyis mdzad cing*/ ma ṇi la sogs pa ma chag par/ 'khrul 'khor la dus rtag par bzhugs pa la/ snyung g.yog pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs la/ dbu sngas la phab nas gzims na bde bar 'dug ste bsams nas/ de gzhan mdzad par zhus pas/ sngar nas/ nyal ba dang bsnyes pa la ma goms/ tsog bu rang bde bar 'dug gsungs zhing*/ sku bsnyel po rang byung dus/ cung bsnyes pa tsam ma gtogs/ dang po snyung nas gshegs pa'i bar/ dbu sngas la ma bzhag par 'khrul 'khor kho na la bzhugs/ nyin zhig phyag skor mdzad pa'i 'phro la/ glo bur du phyag rtsa brtul nas/ mtshar che/ da rung yug gcig mi 'chi bar 'dug ste/ rtsa ni brtul 'dug ltos dang gsungs/ phyag brkyang ba la bltas pas/ rtsa mi 'dug par/ snyung g.yog pa rnams skrag nas/ mchi ma byung*/ the tshom du gyur pa la/ rtsa 'dug ge gsungs/ brtul gda' zhus pas/ de ka 'byung mi 'dug gsungs/ de nas kyang zla phyed tsam bzhugs/ de la 'phros nas/ bla ma rgya ma pas/ phyag rtsa brtul nas yun ring mi thogs zer zhing gda'/ gal te mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nas bde bar gshegs ngo shes na 'pho ba la sogs thugs dam gyi gsal 'debs 'di ltar gyis gsung ba'i zhal ta mi bdog gam zhus pas/

he khyed na re mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nas 'chi na zer te/ shi yang mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa min/ 'di kho yong ba'i grabs shig sngar du tshar/ mi rgan gyi las thabs zin/ lo bdun cu don lnga lon 'dug ste tshe thung thung min/ lo lhag lus pa med/ do gcig nas yon tan 'di 'gro don 'ga' re yong gi 'dug ste/ 'gro don chung du yang mi 'gro mchi/ 'di nas 'di ru 'gro'i gdong gcig yod/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'di dang nam du yang 'bral ma myong*/ na ba'i rkyen gyis rmi lam sor chud 'dug byas pa dang 'dra bar ci yin cha med cig khar seng dpyid po na ba nas bzung ste/ ding sang gi bar la lus la shed med kyang*/ dge sbyor 'phel du song*/ da lta dran 'dzin mi dgos par dge sbyor du 'gro zhing 'dug de lta bu'i ngang nas 'chi ba de ka la phob zer ba yin/ gzhan gsal 'debs bya rgyu ci yang med/ byas kyang dga' ru e yong yang mi shes/ khyed rang rnam pas/ spyod 'jug las gsungs pa'i/ de yi sangs rgyas rjes dran sogs/ / sus kyang g.yengs par 'gyur ba med/ /ces pa/ de dang mi 'gal ba gcig mdzod la nga rang cog ge bsdad pa de ka la/ bcas bcos dang*/ lab lob gang yang ma byed par 'chir chug la/ tsab tsob ma byed cig gsungs pas/ da ci zhu ba bya rgyur mi 'dug pas bsam ngo tsha zhum pa zhig byung*/ yang nyin cig nyi ma la bzhugs dus/ sman bla'i cho ga rgyas pa zhig mi lnga tsam gyis byas pa tshar ba'i yun rings shig nas/ sman bla byas ma byas gsungs/ bgyis tshar la zhus pas/ sman bla'i grabs byed cing 'dug pa yin te/ rjes la dge sbyor mnyam bzhag cig la yengs nas/ cho ga byas pa ma tshor gsungs/ nub cig mchod pa tshar nas gzim mal du phebs thog la/ phud khyer shog gsungs/ gsol ba yin nam bsam khyer phyin pas/ yug zung cig gsungs nas/ phyag 'jug gis 'thor zhing phud mchod rgyas pa re mdzad yang*/ phyag thal mo sbyar zhing dbu thud pa re mdzad/

mchod pa rnam pa lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan lnga tsam bskyar zhing mdzad/ yang phyag thal mo sbyar dbu thud pa re mdzad/ spyan chab mang po byon/ snyung g.yog pa tsho la yang*/ nyid cag pa tsho mchod pa phul gsungs nas/ mar me lha bshos reng bu la sogs pa/ dkon mchog gi drung du bsgrigs pas/ 'dir khyer shog gsungs nas/ mchod pa thams cad la phyag reg pa re mdzad/ dbu thud pa re dang*/ phyag thal mo re sbyar/ de thams cad kyi dus na/ zhal gyi rnam 'gyur tsam ma gtogs pa/ gsung gi 'bru ni ma go nang par sku khrus mdzad dus/ mdang 'di ltar mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ kha sang nas byung ba'i mthong snang za zi de pa byung*/ gzhan yang yi dam 'dra byon pas/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa gyis byas pa yin/ gzhan ci yang shod rgyu mi gda' gsungs nas/ zhib par mi gsungs/ gzigs snang thams cad dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu gda' lags sam zhus pas/ de tsho thams cad la g.yur do ci yod/ rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra/ gang la'ang mngon zhen bya rgyu med gsungs/ yang nang zhig bla ma byang rtse ba dang*/ bla ma rgya ma pa la/ 'o skol rang khrus byed do gsungs/ sku khrus gsol ba'i rjes/ na ning nyid cag dang*/ dge slong 'jam bzang ba la dmar khrid phog pa'i dus na lab byung ba bzhin/ rmi lam 'dzin pa 'di la byang cha chen po yod/ bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing khams blta ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la chos nyan pa la sogs 'bad rtsol mi dgos par yong ba zhig dang po rig pa dngas dus shig tu nam 'dod 'dod bar ma chad du byung*/ bar skabs shig tu 'grib 'dug pa yin te/ ding sang na ba 'dis rmi lam 'dzin pa de sor chud 'dug /ma 'gags pa'i snang ba mtshar ba zhig gda'/ bar skabs su 'grib pa de yang bsod de ka 'dra des kyang lan nam snyam/ lar gyis blo chos su song ba re byung na/ 'jig rten gyi bsod nams chen po skad zer ba 'di kun ma byung na rang dga' ba lags/

'bad rtsol gyis ma bsgrubs par byung na longs spyad du rung zhes sogs kyi dgag sgrub mang po bshad 'dug na'ang*/ 'byor na'ang 'byor pa lam du slong*/ rgud na'ang rgud pa lam du slong ba 'di la ji 'dra ba'i cu gal cig 'dug /de la spros nas/ rmi lam 'dzin pa 'di la gnas dben par bsdad/ mi rtag pa blo thog tu sgom/ 'khor ba la skyo shas drag po bskyed/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la blo khel po yod na/ dmigs pa kun med kyang rtsol med du zin par 'dug /de bzhin min na/ dmigs pa dang 'dun pa rkyang gis zin pa'i nges pa med/ 'on kyang gsang sngags kyi chos 'di thabs kyis khyad par du byas pa yin pas/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad ces gsungs gda' bas/ dmigs pa khyad du gsod mi nyan/ rang rang gi skal ba dang blo'i rig cig la nga 'gro ba yin tshod 'dug gsungs/ rgya ma pas/ bdag gis rmi lam gyi gdams ngag bgyis pas rdugs nas/ zin du ma 'dod zhu ba la nyin bar skyo shas dang 'dun pa btang bas/ rmi lam zin pa la tshegs med gsungs/ yang yi dam zhal gzigs pa'i phyi nub/ bla ma byang rtse ba la/ snyung g.yog gi res yod pa'i srod la/ ma dag pa'i las snang phal cher 'gags nas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ dngas shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rgya khyon dang*/ tshad 'di yin zhes rtsa ba nas gzhal ba mi nus pa zhig 'dug gsung zhing*/ phyag nam mkha' la yug yug mdzad de/ mnan na nems kyis byed cing*/ btegs na 'phar gyis byed pa la sogs pa mtshar du che ba zhig gi dbus na/ rang re 'dug pa/ de'i tsa na nad g.yog byed cing yod pa'i bag chags yin mchi bas/ bla ma rgya ma pa'ang 'dug /de'i khor yug kun na 'khor gyi tshogs grangs las 'das pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi snang ba za zi lang long brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig 'dug ste/ da ni mgyogs por 'gro bar 'dug gis gsungs so/

/yang snga dro zhig mdang rmi lam bzung ba yin te/ lan cig zin la khad yod pas/ ma zin pa ka 'dra cig byung*/ phal cher zin cing 'dug nga ltar yang rgod bro ba zhig byung gsungs/ zhal 'dzum mul le/ phyag mdzub g.yas nam mkha' la ker mdzad nas/ rmi lam na dar ser po zhig 'dug pa tshur blangs pas/ de'i shul na tshur gser mang po byung*/ de nas gser theg tshad cig kha che paṇa chen la phul yod/ mdang ni kho bos kha che paṇa chen la zhabs tog chen po bgyis pas/ paṇa chen yang*/ bdag la rab tu mnyes nas shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul dang bcas nas gda'o gsung ngo*/ /paṇa chen gang na bzhugs pa lags zhus pas/ byams pa'i drung na bzhugs pa yin gsungs/ yang*/ snga dro gcig sus kyang zhus pa med par/ sngon gyi dus na dpon chen kun dga' bzang po la/ kha chems 'jog par zhus pas/ kha chems 'di bzang du song tsa na byed zer ba'i gtam zhig 'dug ste/ de bzhin du rang re'i 'di la nad 'di phan nas khams bzang du 'gro rgyu zhig mi yong*/ thag ring nas yong zer ba 'ga' res/ gdams ngag tshig bzhi pa re yi ger khod blangs zer ba dang*/ slob dpon ras rkyang pa rgyal mtshan dar gyis kyang*/ don gyis na kha chems 'dri ba'i yi ge zhig bskur 'dug ste/ kha chems 'jog pa skabs su bab 'dug na'ang*/ nad kyis gdungs/ lus kyi shed zad/ rig pa'i ngar chag pa'i dus 'di 'drar song tsa na/ tshig bzhi pa re rtsom pa dang*/ lab pa la'ang cung gal chen po yong gin 'dug /lar gyis/ 'o skol khams bzang dus na'ang*/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la yang*/ khrigs kha 'di yin gyi tig tig med par gtong gin yod pa de yin mod/ da 'chi kha dang*/ shi ba'i rjes la de bas kyang 'di ltar byed kyi khrigs kha ga na yong*/ gal te kha ta la nyan mkhan yod na/ sngar khams bzang dus/ rig pa dwangs dus su/ rang gis shes tshad chos mthun du byas nas bshad/ rtsom pa'ang che chung ci rigs su byas shing*/

khyad par du/ tshigs bcad che chung mang dag cig yi ger bkod yod pa/ de rnams kha chems yin te de ma gtogs/ dor zhag rig pa so na med pa'i 'brel med kyi tshig rdaug gsum smras pa la sod med/ de ka la bsams nas/ sngar yang*/ phrad kyang 'di las gzhan pa smra rgyu med/ shi yang kha chems gzhan 'ga' ma mchis so/ /zhes pa/ de ka yin no gsungs/ kun la gsung gi tha ma man ngag 'ga' zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ snying dang 'dra ba'i grogs la mdo rgyud kyi/ / snying po bsdus pa'i man ngag sngar nyid du/ / snying brtses kun nas bslangs nas bsnyad pa lags/ / snying gi dkyil du chug la nyams su longs/ / lus bde khams bzang rig pa dwangs dus su/ / gang shes dpe mkhyud med par bstan pa lags/ / da lta khams ngan rig pa mi gsal ba'i/ / 'brel med tshig 'ga' smras kyang dgos pa chung*/ / mdor na bla ma chos nyid rgyal mtshan la/ / gdams pa phyi ma de nyid nyams su bzhes/ /zhes gsungs/ drung nas/ zhing khams gzhan du 'gro ba'i don rgya che lags kyang*/ bdag cag mgon med pa rnams kyi don la bzhugs bar zhu zhus pa yod na/ 'gro ba thams cad kyang spro na blo gtad pa khyed la lta ci smos/ gsung bzhin ma bsgrubs na lhan cig 'grogs kyang dgos pa med de/ sman pa'i ngag ma mnyan na sman dag gis/ / bcos dgos nad pa sos par ga la 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don soms la/ nga bla ma dang bral snyam pa'i mya ngan ma byed par/ rtse gcig tu gsol ba thob/ man ngag la nyams len gyis/ kho bo yod pa dang mtshungs pa'i byin rlabs 'byung zhing*/ rang gzhan gyi don 'grub/ de bas lhag pa'i gdam ngag med cing*/ khyad par du/ ston pa zla bzang rang yang*/ dge sbyor la 'bad pa thon kha chems dang*/ lam rgyu'i dngos po de ka yin/ nus pa byung tshad kyis snyoms chung la byams su byed pa dang*/ da lta rang res skyong dgos kyin yod pa'i ma nus pa 'di rnams la/ skyan ran legs po gyis sdug ge rnams khong sngon la shi
