/nged tsho ma shi bar shul du lus pa 'di 'dra zhig byung zer sdug bsngal chen po byed du yong bas na/ 'di rnams snying rje ba yin no/ /zhes lan gnyis su gsungs shing spyan chab bton/ yang*/ sdug ge rnams snying rje snying rje zhes pa lan gsum gsungs/ yang bla ma rgya ma pa la/ bla ma pa'ang*/ cam cam mi byed par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa zhig re ba yin na'ang*/ sa gcig tu 'dug tshugs zer ba de yang mi 'dug ste/ blo chos su song ba gcig 'dug pas rjes su yi rang*/ khyed rang gi da lta'i byed lugs 'di bzhin byas na/ sngar yang lab byung ba bzhin khyed rang la dgra gnyen mang po yod par 'dug na'ang*/ dgra'i gnod pa mi yong ba'i khag ngas khur bas chog /da rung gnyen gyi phye mthor ma zug pa gyis la/ bya bral mthar thon pa mdzad par zhu gsungs nas phyag thal mo sbyar byung bas/ khong pa'i lus thams cad sbrid pa lta bur gyur cing*/ mchi ma rang dbang med par shor byung*/ de bzhin du bgyid par zhu lags shing drung nas bdag cag sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ de ka lags kyi gsungs nas dbu phyogs pa zhig mdzad/ zhabs drung nas yod pa rnams kyis/ zhing khams gang du skye ba bzhes lags zhus pas/ 'gro la phan na dmyal ba'ang shin tu bzod cing*/ sems can la mi phan na/ dag pa'i zhing khams la'ang dgos pa mi gda'/ de rnams kho bo rang la dbang mi gda' bas/ dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing*/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam btab nas/ gzhan la phan pa'i lus shig thob tu re ba yin gsungs/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs/ slob dpon dpal ye'i snyung g.yog gi res la yod pas/ slob dpon nga mdun du tsog pu gyis shig gsungs/ de gong sku rgyab byang du bstan yod pas/ zhal byang du bsgyur nas/ spyod lam gcig pu de ka'i ngang nas/ nang par nyi shar bar du mnyam bzhag rtse gcig las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa la/

zhabs drung pa rnams la/ bde bar gshegs zin pa yin nam snyam pa byung*/ bar skabs su gsung ci rigs pa 'byon yang 'bru ma go nas/ nang par tsha ba'i dus su/ mdang spyod lam 'di bzhin mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ nga'i za zi de rnams kyis slob dpon 'o rgyal la gtad/ nyid cag lkog tu bcug yin pa dag nga bsnyes pa mi nyal byas pa de'i mdun na/ rje btsun ma byon nas bzhugs 'dug pas/ rje btsun ma'i mdun du nga nyal nas bsdad pas mi yong*/ tsog langs la gsol ba gdab dgos snyam nas de ltar byas pa yin zhing*/ yang rje btsun ma/ byang nas lhor zhal gzigs 'dug pa la/ rang res kyang de phyogs la bltas nas/ gsol ba btab lags gsungs/ rje btsun ma rnal 'byor ma lags sam/ sgrol ma lags zhus pas/ spyan nam ka la cher ba zhig mdzad nas/ sgrol ma sgrol ma zhes gsum gsungs/ rje btsun ma gsung 'byon gyi gda' lags sam zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas/ he de 'dra mi 'dug ste/ 'o skol ngos kyis sems can gyi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas/ rje btsun ma la yus mang po btsongs gsungs/ yang dge sbyor lags sam mdang zhag ni sna tshogs shig la yengs gda'o gsungs/ slob dpon dpal yes/ glang thang pa'i zhal nas/ nga dmyal bar skye bar 'dod nas/ smon lam mang du btab pa yin te/ mi 'grub pa 'dra/ da lta dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig las/ tha mal gyi snang ba tsam mi 'dug ces pa/ de bzhin byung ba ma lags sam zhus pas/ phal cher rang min nam/ yin pa dag kyang srid/ 'on kyang 'khrul ba rnams la gtad ka ci bdog gsungs/ de nas thugs rje'i shugs kyis bshums pa yun ring zhing*/ thugs rje drags la song nas/ glo bur du gser ma'am sku khams log na 'jigs par gda' bas/ ding sang mtshan bcas kyi thugs dam rnams glod pa dang*/ khyad par snying rje'i dmigs pa mi mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ thabs shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i phyir/ mtshan med kyi dge sbyor la mtshan bcas kyis mi gnod gda' zhing*/

blo'i rtsol ba cung zad yod kyang byed par spro la/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dran tsam na/ snying rje'i dmigs pa ched kyi ma bzung yang*/ ngang gis skye zhing*/ byung rgyal du btang na khyed rnams ya nga bas dran 'dzin chen po byas pa lags/ spyod 'jug las/ de tshe bsod nams gcig skyabs na/ /zhes gsungs pas/ na 'chi byung dus/ lhag par dge ba la sbyor ba yin gsung ngo*/ /bcu dgu'i tho rangs kyi dus su/ cung zhig slongs shig gsungs nas/ de ltar byas pas/ bde mo zhig byung lags pas/ 'di ka la bcas bcos ci yang ma byed cig gsungs/ de nas bzung ste/ sang nyi shu'i dgongs ja'i bar/ spros med kyi ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' ba de mngon du mdzad kyang*/ gzugs kyi sprul pa'i sku de nyid/ gnyis 'dzin 'khrul bas bslad pa rnams kyi blo ngor sa mo bya lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub pa dang mnyam du/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de nas zhag bdun gyi bar du gsang yod pa la/ lha'i me tog gi char rgyun ma chad par babs pas/ 'ga' res mthong nas/ da bde bar gshegs pa'i snga ltas sam/ yang na sku khams dngas pa'i rtags yin nam zer zhing*/ mtshams dam po la yod pa'i sgom chen rnams la/ de bar sngar ma myong ba'i nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes shing*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la tshe gang 'bad pa bas kyang*/ tshes nyi shu dang*/ nyer gcig gi dus su sgom bogs che ba byung zhing*/ gdung gzhu ba'i nyin/ nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od dkar po bris pa lta bus 'khor ba'i bar thams cad 'ja' tshon kha dog sna lngas spel ba ltar bkra zhing*/ nam mkha'i dkyil thams cad shin tu dngas shing 'od gsal ba dang*/ sa gzhi thams cad tshub ma med cing yul 'jam pa dang*/ bar snang thams cad lha'i me tog dkar po char ltar babs pas/

shin tu rmongs pa'i gang zag thar pa'i rigs chad pa rnams kyang*/ dad pa glo bur du skyes shing mchi ma'i rgyun babs/ ba spu zing zhing cho nge'i sgra 'byin na/ gzhan rnams lta ci smos te/ 'dus pa thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i ltas de dag gis bskul nas/ mos pa dang gus pa'i gdung shugs lhag par 'phel bar gyur to/ /de nas bzung ste/ zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar du nam mkha' la sprin med dwangs par gyur pa ni/ 'od gsal spros med phyag rgya chen po mngon du gyur pa'i mtshon byed yin no zhes gleng la/ yid du 'ong ba'i ser bu cung zad ma gtogs rlung chen po rnams kyang 'jam dal gyis zhi ste/ zhing pa rnams kyi g.yul byed pa bul bar byung zhes kyang grag go /sa yang cher g.yos shing*/ me tog gi char spur khang gi dud khung nas zhugs nas/ bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i khung bu nas phyung zhing*/ sngar yang spur gyi thugs khar thim pa dang*/ zhugs me spar ma thag sku'i nang na yang me 'bar zhing*/ dbu'i spyi gtsug skya thal song ba'i dkyil na yar/ mar me ltar ta le 'bar ba la der yod pa rnams mthong snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ tha dad du mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba ni/ shar nas 'od dkar po snam bu brkyang ba lta bu dngul chu'i ri la zug ste/ slar shar phyogs su thim pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis byang phyogs nas 'od dar yug brkyang ba lta bu gzims khang la zug ste/ slar byang phyogs su thim pa dang*/ la las/ 'od nyi ma shar ba lta bus/ chos rdzong la bskor te nub phyogs su thim pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis/ nam mkha'i mthongs nas skras pa brkyang ba lta bu'i 'od gzims khang la zug ste/ mthar nam mkha'i dbyings su yal ba dang*/ de dag dang mtshungs par/ dbus phyogs dang*/ chu zhal la stod lho byang la sogs par yang*/ nyin par 'ja'i tshogs 'khrug pa dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab cing*/ mtshan mo 'od dang sgra chen po dang*/ sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas ngo mtshar ba byung zhing*/

khyad par spur 'ju ba'i nyin me tog gi char chen po mjad lung par babs shing*/ dag pa'i snang ba can 'ba' zhig gis/ chos rje pa spyan ras gzigs kha sar pā ṇis spyan drangs nas bde ba can du gshegs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas spyan drangs te/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su gshegs pa dang*/ la la dag gis/ kha che paṇa chen gyis gdan drangs te dga' ldan du gshegs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis lha dang lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas/ sil snyan la sogs mchod pa'i khyad par du mas yongs su bskor te po ta lar gshegs pa dang*/ la las ni seng ge la chibs nas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas bskor te/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su 'deng gsung ba'i gsung lhang lhang ba dang bcas te mngon dgar gshegs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis mchod rten dkar po bar snang khengs pa zhig gi bang rim la rim gyis 'dzegs nas byon te/ mthar bum pa'i steng du bzhugs nas de la bskor ba mdzad cing*/ rdo rje dril bu'i sgra sil sil sgrog bzhin du/ 'o skol rang 'og min du 'gro'o gsungs zhing*/ mchod rten dang bcas pa nam mkha'i mthongs su gshegs pa'i rjes su/ de nyid kyis kyang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yin zer ba'i bar du phyag phyi la byon cing*/ de nas kyang chos rje'i gsung gis/ yar shog yar shog gsungs pa'i sgra lhang lhang thos kyang*/ ji zhig ltar na/ gzhal yas khang mig gis ma bzod nas/ long ba ltar gyur te slar lhung ma thabs su log la yong dgos pa byung ngo zhes pa dang*/ yang 'ga' zhig gis ni/ khyed rnams kyi bla ma gshegs pa yin yong*/ nga'i rgyal sras chos rje ni/ da dung chos rdzong na sku khams bzang zhing sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs yod/ ces sogs dang*/ 'ga' zhig bla ma rin po che snyung nas bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ chos rje'i thugs la ji ltar dgongs tshul la sogs/ khyed rtsar bsdad pa bas nga rgyus che zer ba la sogs pa mthong snang mi 'dra ba/

'ga' zhig la mngon sum dang*/ 'ga' zhig sgom nyams dang*/ la la rmi lam bzung ba'i nyams myong sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams snang la byung ngo zhes grag go /spur khang gshig dus/ dbu thod la mkhal ril po ma nyams par byon la/ ring bsrel shin tu phra ba chu shel lam/ mu tig gi kha dog lta bu dngas shing 'od 'tsher ba'i rang bzhin can mang po byon zhing*/ 'phan yul nyan po'i dge bshes dpal rin zhes bya ba la/ zhal bzhugs dus tshems bud pa zhig gnang zhing*/ dus phyis mya ngan las 'das nas/ zla ba drug song rting*/ tshems de la dung g.yas 'khyil rtse mo nyi zlas brgyan pa byon pa dang*/ mtshur phu ba'i mi nyag dge bshes shig gi gdung skal la bde mchog byon pa dang*/ snar thang pa'i dge bshes shig gis gdung skal spyan drangs pa la/ sman bla'i sku byon/ e pa'i dge bshes shig gis spyan drangs pa la/ thugs rje chen po byon/ skyor mo lung pa'i dge bshes shig gis spyan drangs pa la a dang dung g.yas 'khyil byon/ bla ma rog pa tshang ba la/ ring bsrel las grub pa'i sgrol ma'i sku byon/ 'jad pa'i yon bdag cig gis spyan drangs pa'i gdung skal la/ don zhags kyi sku byon 'dug /ces pa la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang bas/ 'dir yi ge mang kyis dogs shing*/ gtso che ba rnams smos so/ /de dag gis ni chos kyi rje rgyal sras rin po che pa de nyid gdul bya'i don la/ zhing 'di nyid du bsam bzhin du/ sku skye ba bzhes te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor rab tu byon nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa dang*/ gdul bya mang po'i mgon skyabs dang*/ 'dren pa dam pa mdzad pa la sogs pa'i tshul cung zad tsam zhig /rang gzhan gyi mos gus kyi dran pa gso ba'i phyir/ yi ger bris pa'o/ /nyes par gyur pa rnams/ blo sbyangs mkhas pa mos gus kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol lo/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar dpag yas rnams/

/bdag blo dman pas rtogs par mi nus kyang*/ /gus ldan slob mas mang du gsol btab ngor/ /phan pa'i bsam pas mdzad tshul 'di byas so/ /sgro btags skur pas dben pa'i rnam thar 'di/ /tshig gi sdeb sbyor mkhas pa ma mchis kyang*/ /bla ma'i yon tan don la gnas pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan 'ga' zhig 'di la slob 'dod pa/ /de la bla ma'i byin brlabs 'jug par 'gyur/ /dad med log lta shas ches 'di mthong nas/ /mi gus skur 'debs sdig spyod de dag kyang*/ /thugs rje che mnga' dpal ldan bla ma de'i/ /lhag par brtse ba'i yul du rab dgongs 'gyur/ /de phyir mthong thos dran reg 'tshengs gyur pa'i/ /'brel tshad don ldan byang chub thugs gnyis kyis/ /rnam par slan pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs 'di/ /sa steng kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad tshul la/ /mos gus tshad 'dzin 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ /skyes mchog sems dpa' chen po de nyid dang*/ /mos gus spyan ldan rnams la bzod par gsol/ /dge des 'gro ba'i sdig dang sdug bsngal kun/ /bdag la smin cing bdag gi dge bde rnams// gzhan la sbyin mdzad chos rje bla ma de'i/ /sgrub rgyud bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel gyur cig /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab spyan ldan pas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro kun bdag mdzad phyir/ /gzhan don dka' spyad khur gyis mi skyo ba'i/ /rgyal sras chos rje bla ma'i bkra shis shog/dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rje/ 'jig rten gsum na bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa/ dad pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i/ shar gling chen mo'i gdan sa pa mkhan po chos kyi 'od zer ba dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa du mas snga gong nas bskul zhing*/ 'phral nyid du chos 'khor gling pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang dag gis bskul nas/

shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ chos grwa chen po tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por/ stag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sbyar ba'o// //dge legs dang bkra shis chen po rgyas par gyur cig /rgyal sras chos rje bla ma'i rnam thar 'di/ /mtshan thos dad pa'i sa gzhi rab g.yo bas/ / rnam par 'dod te btsal yang yun ring du/ /ma rnyed mod kyi chos rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /phyis na rnyed te bris pa'i dge ba ni/ /rgyal sras bla ma'i thugs dgongs ji 'dra bar/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i 'bras 'byin pa'i/ /byang chub spyod pa'i lam la 'jug par shog /bdag kyang chos las nam yang ma g.yos par/ /chos rje bla mas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces smras nas bsod nams rin chen bdag gis/ mgyogs par bris pa lags so// // shubhaṃ/
